blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Statistically valid estimation of racial and ethnic disparities often requires inferring the probability that an individual belongs to a particular racial or ethnic group given only their name and geographic location. The standard approach, Bayesian Improved Surname Geocoding (BISG), relies on group population frequencies for each name. Although the U.S. Census Bureau provides such information for common names and a limited set of racial categories, comparable data do not exist for many racial and ethnic groups and are rarely available outside the U.S. We propose the list-powered BISG ( ℓ \ell BISG) method, which can be used to derive calibrated group probabilities from group-specific name lists. These lists may be compiled based on expert knowledge or generated synthetically using large language models (LLMs), and thus may be subject to unknown biases. Representing names as embeddings, we treat list membership as a proxy prediction task and apply a correction based on proximal inference to recover the target group probabilities. We validate the method on U.S. voter files with self-reported race, on the full-count 1900 U.S. Census, and on the Lebanese voter registry. We find that LLM-generated name lists yield accurate and well-calibrated probabilities as well as precise disparity estimates comparable to those obtained using methods that require name–race data.
Thus, ℓ \ell BISG substantially broadens the applicability of probabilistic race and ethnicity prediction to settings where name–race data are unavailable. Keywords: Bayesian Improved Surname Geocoding, embeddings, large language models, proximal inference, racial disparity
blocks.zh:
从统计上看,对种族和族裔差别的估计往往需要推断一个人仅仅由于姓名和地理位置而属于某一种族或族裔群体的可能性。 标准方法"Bayesian改进了姓氏地理编码"(BISG),每个名称都依赖于群体人口频率. 虽然美国人口调查局为通用名和有限的一组种族类别提供此类信息,但对于许多种族和民族群体,可比较的数据并不存在,并且很少在美国以外地区提供. 我们提出了列表动力的BISG(l\ell BISG)方法,可用于从特定群体的名字列表中得出校正组概率. 这些清单可能根据专家知识汇编,或使用大型语言模型合成生成,因此可能存在未知的偏差。 代表名字是嵌入式的,我们把列表成员作为代理预测任务,并根据近缘推论进行校正来恢复目标群体的概率. 我们验证自报种族的美国选民档案、1900年美国人口普查和黎巴嫩选民登记册上的方法。 我们发现,LLM生成的名字清单产生准确和精确的概率,以及精确的相差估计值,与使用需要姓名-种族数据的方法获得的数字相当。
因此,我转告BISG将概率种族和族裔预测的可适用性大幅扩大到没有姓名-种族数据的地方。 关键词: Bayesian 改进了姓氏地理编码,嵌入,大语言模型,近相推论,种族差异

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Measuring racial and ethnic disparities across social, economic, and political domains requires information about individuals’ race in administrative and other records ( Adjaye-Gbewonyo et al., 2014 ; Fraga, 2018 ; Greenwald et al., 2024 , e.g.,) . However, race is often unavailable because it is withheld by law or omitted due to privacy concerns and the sensitivity of collecting such information ( Fiscella and Fremont, 2006 ) . As a result, researchers must infer individuals’ racial or ethnic group membership from the information that is available, most commonly their name and place of residence.
blocks.zh: 衡量社会、经济和政治领域的种族和族裔差异需要行政和其他记录中有关个人种族的信息(Adjaye-Gbewonyo等,2014年;Fraga,2018年;Greenwald等,2024年等)。 然而,由于隐私问题和收集这类信息的敏感性,法律禁止或忽略了种族,因此,种族往往得不到保护(Fiscella和Fremont,2006年)。 因此,研究人员必须根据现有资料推断个人的种族或族裔群体成员,最常见的是其姓名和居住地。

blocks.en: Bayesian Improved Surname Geocoding (BISG) combines surname-based racial information, derived from the U.S. Census Bureau’s surname list, with the racial composition of an individual’s place of residence to estimate individual race probabilities. The method assumes that surname and geolocation are conditionally independent given unobserved race ( Elliott et al., 2009 ; Imai and Khanna, 2016 ; Imai et al., 2022 ) . BISG has been extended to incorporate first names, resulting in the Bayesian Improved First Name Surname Geocoding (BIFSG) method ( Voicu, 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 贝叶斯人改良姓氏地理编码(BISG)将取自美国人口普查局姓氏表的以姓氏为基础的种族信息与个人居住地的种族组成结合起来,以估计个人种族概率. 该方法假定,在无观察种族的情况下,姓氏和地理位置是有条件独立的(Elliott等,2009年;Imai和Khanna,2016年;Imai等,2022年)。 BISG被扩展为包含先名,由此形成了巴耶斯语改进后名姓氏地理编码(BIFSG)方法(Voicu,2018.

blocks.en: BISG has become the standard approach for racial demographic inference across many domains. Its applications range from fair lending enforcement ( Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, 2014 ; Greenwald et al., 2024 ) to studies of health disparities ( Adjaye-Gbewonyo et al., 2014 ) and racial turnout gaps in voting ( Fraga, 2018 ) , and it is supported by widely used software implementations ( Khanna et al., 2024 ) . BISG returns a probability for each individual belonging to each group, which is essential for downstream statistical analyses. Probabilistic outputs enable unbiased estimation of group disparities in settings where deterministic classifications can introduce bias ( McCartan et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: BISG已成为许多领域的种族人口推论的标准方法。 其应用范围从公平放贷执法(消费者金融保护局,2014;Greenwald等,2024)到健康差距研究(Adjaye-Gbewonyo等,2014)和投票的种族投票率差距(Fraga,2018)等,并得到了广泛应用的软件实施支持(Khanna等,2024). BISG为每个属于每个群体的个人返回概率,这对于下游统计分析至关重要。 概率性产出使得在决定性分类可带来偏见的环境下对群体差异作出无偏见的估计(McCartan等,2025年)。

blocks.en: However, BISG requires data that exist in few settings: a surname-by-race frequency table (and BIFSG additionally requires an analogous table for first names) and the geographic prevalence of each racial group. For these reasons, BISG is most commonly applied in the United States. The U.S. Census Bureau publishes the former tables only for “frequently occurring” names – names that appear at least 100 times in the Census returns – and provides these tables for a limited set of racial categories ( U.S. Census Bureau, 2016 ) . Detailed geographic distributions of groups are similarly confined to these few racial categories. Consequently, individuals with uncommon names receive only an uninformative geography-based prior, and the group memberships for which BISG can be plausibly estimated are few. The required data are unavailable for more detailed ethnic groups and for most countries outside the United States.
blocks.zh: 然而,BISG需要少数情况下存在的数据:一个按种族的取名频率表(而BIFSG还需要一个同名的取名表)和每个种族群体的地域普遍程度. 由于这些原因,BISG在美国应用最为普遍. 美国人口调查局只公布前几表的"经常发生的"名称,这些名称至少在人口普查资料中出现过100次,并提供这些表格的少数种族类别(美国人口调查局,2016年). 团体的详细地理分布同样仅限于这些少数种族类别。 因此,名字不同寻常的个人以前只收到基于非信息化的地理资料,而可以合理地估计BISG的团体成员很少。 对于更详细的族裔群体以及美国以外的大多数国家来说,没有所需的数据。

blocks.en: We propose list-powered BISG ( ℓ \ell BISG), which estimates calibrated race probabilities without requiring a name-by-race frequency table (Section 2 ). We consider two settings: a setting in which geographic prevalence is available for all groups of interest and a limited information setting in which geographic prevalence is either unavailable or available only for coarser groups (Section 3 ). The proposed ℓ \ell BISG relies on relatively short, approximate group-specific name lists, which can be compiled from expert knowledge or generated synthetically using large language models (LLMs) (Section 4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们提议以列表为动力的BISG(l\ell BISG),它估算校准的种族概率而不需要一个逐个种族的频率表(第2节). 我们考虑两种环境:一种是向所有利益群体提供地理流行率,另一种是有限的信息环境,即没有地理流行率,或只有较弱群体才能获得(第3节)。 拟议的l\ell BISG依赖于相对短而大致的团体特定名称列表,这些列表可以从专家知识中编译出,或者使用大型语言模型合成生成(第4节).

blocks.en: To leverage these lists, we first embed names into a vector space, in which morphologically and linguistically similar names are close to one another ( Ye et al., 2017 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Dasanaike, 2026 ; Dasanaike and Imai, 2026 ) . We then apply a proximal inference approach ( Kuroki and Pearl, 2014 ) to recover race probabilities from a model that predicts whether a name embedding belongs to a given list. We also show that if the information about geographic prevalence is available, then ℓ \ell BISG can recover individual race probabilities by using embeddings alone without name lists so long as spatial clustering of the embeddings is informative about group membership. However, name lists play an essential role in diagnostics of ℓ \ell BISG as well as in its application in the absence of geographic prevalence information.
blocks.zh: 为了利用这些列表,我们首先将名字嵌入向量空间,其中形态学和语言学上相似的名字相近(Ye等,2017;Wang等,2024;Dasanaike,2026;Dasanaike和Imai,2026). 然后,我们采用近缘推论方法(Kuroki and Pearl, 2014)从一个预测某个名字嵌入是否属于特定列表的模型中恢复种族概率. 我们还表明,如果有关于地理分布的信息,那么只要对嵌入物进行空间分组,了解群体成员情况,l\ell BISG就可以单独使用没有姓名清单的嵌入物来恢复个人种族概率。 然而,姓名清单在诊断l \ ell BISG以及在缺乏地理流行信息的情况下的应用方面发挥着至关重要的作用。

blocks.en: Like standard BISG ( Voicu, 2018 ) , ℓ \ell BISG naturally extends to incorporating group-specific first name lists, yielding what we call ℓ \ell BIFSG. Moreover, because ℓ \ell BISG produces calibrated group probabilities, it can also substitute for BISG in downstream analyses. For instance, ℓ \ell BISG can be used with the BIRDiE model ( McCartan et al., 2025 ) , which enables valid estimation of group disparities with respect to a given outcome under the assumption that the outcome is independent of name given race and geography.
blocks.zh: 与标准BISG(Voicu, 2018)一样,l\ellBISG自然延伸至包含特定群体的首名名单,产生我们所谓的l\ell BIFSG. 此外,由于l\ellBISG产生校正组概率,它也可以取而代之地下游分析中的BISG. 例如,l\ell BISG可以与BIRDIE模型(McCartan等,2025年)相接而来,该模型能够有效估计特定结果方面的群体差异,其假设是,结果与给定的种族和地理无关。

blocks.en: We evaluate the empirical performance of ℓ \ell BISG using three datasets with individual-level ground truth (Section 5 ): (1) the Florida and North Carolina voter files, which include self-reported race for registered voters; (2) the complete-count 1900 U.S. Census, which enumerates Chinese and Japanese as separate ethnic groups ( Nelson et al., 2025 ) ; and (3) the 2018 Lebanese voter file, scraped from government records, which contains individuals’ self-reported religious sect. Because these settings include ethnic groups and religious sects, we use the terms race, ethnicity, and group interchangeably throughout the paper. Across these settings, ℓ \ell BISG achieves prediction accuracy and probability calibration comparable to those of BISG, and otherwise performs well even where the requisite data for BISG are unattainable. We also show that this strong performance carries over to downstream analyses, with ℓ \ell BISG yielding group disparity estimates nearly identical to those obtained using BISG under the BIRDiE framework ( McCartan et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们使用三个具有个人层面地面真相的数据集(第5节)来评价BISG的经验性表现:(1)佛罗里达州和北卡罗来纳州的选民档案,其中包括注册选民的自报种族;(2)1900年美国人口普查的完整统计,其中将中日两国列为单独的族群(Nelson等,2025年);(3)2018年黎巴嫩选民档案从政府记录中取出,其中包含个人自报的宗教派别. 由于这些环境包括了族群和宗教派别,我们在整个论文中交替使用种族、族裔和团体等术语。 通过这些设置,l\ell BISG实现与BISG相仿的预测准确性和概率校正,否则即使BISG的必要数据无法达到,也会表现良好. 我们还表明,这种强效表现一直延续到下游分析,而我/ell BISG得出的群体差异估计与根据BIRDIE框架(McCartan等,2025年)使用BISG获得的估计数几乎相同。

blocks.en: By eliminating the need for name–race frequency tables and requiring only easily constructed name lists, ℓ \ell BISG substantially broadens the scope of race and ethnicity imputation.
blocks.zh: I\ell BISG通过取消对命名-种族频率表的需要,只需要容易构建的名称表,大大地扩大了种族和族裔划分的范围。

blocks.en: A growing literature seeks to overcome the limitations of the Census surname list that BISG requires by training machine learning models to infer race or ethnicity directly from names. Character-level and transformer-based models predict race from the sequence of letters in a name ( Chintalapati et al., 2018 ; Parasurama, 2021 ) ; interpretable models leverage patterns in name popularity ( Jain et al., 2022 ) ; and embedding-based approaches learn representations of names from social and communication data without using race labels ( Ye et al., 2017 ; Ye and Skiena, 2019 ) . More recently, LLMs have been used to infer ethnicity, religious sect, or caste from names without task-specific training, both in the United States and elsewhere ( Dasanaike, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 越来越多的文献试图通过培训机器学习模式从名字中直接推断种族或族裔,来克服BISG要求的人口普查姓氏清单的局限性. 以字符级别和变压器为基础的模型从一个名字的字母序列中预测出种族(Chintalapati等,2018;Parasurama等,2021;可解释模型在名字受欢迎度中的杠杆模式(Jain等,2022;并嵌入法在不使用种族标签的情况下从社会和通信数据中学习名字的表示(Ye等,2017;Ye和Skiena等,2019). 最近,在美国和其他地方,LLMs被用来从未经具体任务培训的名字中推断族裔、宗教派别或种姓(Dasanaike,2026年)。

blocks.en: These approaches typically assign each individual to a single group and are often proposed as alternatives to BISG. However, classification errors make naïvely treating these predictions as ground truth problematic, leading to biased estimates in downstream disparity analyses ( Chen et al., 2019 ; Xin et al., 2026 ) . Rather than replacing BISG, ℓ \ell BISG leverages the outputs of these and other classifiers to recover calibrated probabilistic predictions, which can then be used for statistically valid downstream inference ( McCartan et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 这些办法通常将每个人划入一个单一的群体,并经常被提议作为BISG的替代品。 然而,分类错误使这些预测被天真地当作地表真理存在问题,导致下游差异分析中的偏差估计(Chen等,2019;Xin等,2026). I\ell BISG不取代BISG,而是利用这些分类器和其他分类器的产出来恢复被校正的概率预测,然后用于统计上有效的下游推断(McCartan等,2025年).

blocks.en: A number of existing methods extend BISG itself. As noted above, Voicu (2018) incorporates first-name information through an additional Bayes factor (BIFSG), while Imai et al. (2022) develops a fully Bayesian version (fBISG) that accounts for potential measurement error in the Census surname data. Rosenman et al. (2023) augments the Census surname list with name dictionaries derived from Southern voter files, and Dasanaike and Imai (2026) replaces the uninformative prior for uncommon surnames with embedding-based predictions (eBISG). Lastly, Greengard and Gelman (2025) improves the calibration of BISG probabilities to relax BISG’s usual surname-geography conditional independence assumption. Nevertheless, all of these methods rely on a name-race frequency table. In contrast, ℓ \ell BISG eliminates this requirement while remaining compatible with the same downstream analyses and naturally extending to incorporate first-name information (Sections 2.6 and 5.1 ).
blocks.zh: 一些现有方法扩展了英属维尔京群岛本身。 如上所述,Voicu(2018年)通过一个额外的Bayes因子(BIFSG)纳入一称信息,而Imai等. (2022年)开发出完全的巴耶斯语版本(fBISG)来说明人口普查姓氏数据中可能存在的测量错误. Rosenman等人(2023年)用南方选民档案中出自的名字词典来补充人口普查姓氏清单,而Dasanaike和Imai(2026年)则用嵌入式预测(eBISG)来取代非常见姓氏之前的无信息. 最后,格林加德和盖尔曼(2025年)改进了BISG概率的校正,以放松BISG通常的姓氏地理条件独立假设. 尽管如此,所有这些方法都依赖于一个取名率频率表. 与此相反,I\ell BISG取消了这一要求,同时与同样的下游分析保持相容,并自然延伸为纳入一称信息(第2.6和5.1节)。

blocks.en: Curated name lists have long been used to identify and sample members of specific populations. Distinctive surname lists have been developed for American Jews ( Himmelfarb et al., 1983 ) , Asian Americans ( Lauderdale and Kestenbaum, 2000 ) , and, with formal validation, South Asian and Chinese populations in administrative health data ( Shah et al., 2010 ) . These approaches often use curated lists as deterministic filters, classifying individuals solely on the basis of whether their names appear on the list (see Chasalow et al. (2026) for an exception). In contrast, ℓ \ell BISG treats a list as a noisy proxy and generalizes beyond the listed names using name embeddings, allowing previously unseen names to receive informative probabilistic predictions.
blocks.zh: 久而久之,使用被验证的名字清单来识别和抽样特定人群的成员. 为美国犹太人(Himmelfarb等,1983年),亚裔美国人(Laudardale和Kestenbaum,2000年)以及经正式验证的行政健康数据中的南亚和中国人口(Shah等,2010年)制定了不同的姓氏名单。 这些方法往往使用经整理的清单作为确定性过滤器,仅根据个人姓名是否出现在清单中来进行分类(例外情况见Chasalow等人(2026年))。 与此相对照,l\ell BISG将一个列表当作一个吵闹的代名词,并使用名字嵌入来概括列表之外的名字,允许之前未见的名字收到信息性概率预测.

blocks.en: Finally, name-based prediction is increasingly used to measure representation. Recent applications include inferring the race of public officials ( Lee and Velez, 2025 ) and evaluating machine-learning variants of BISG for redistricting ( Curiel and DeLuca, 2024 ) . At the same time, prediction errors have been shown to distort the downstream analyses that rely on these predictions ( Argyle and Barber, 2024 ; Greenwald et al., 2024 ) . By making calibrated probabilistic predictions available for a much broader range of groups and settings, ℓ \ell BISG extends the scope of these applications while supporting statistically valid downstream inference.
blocks.zh: 最后,基于名的预测越来越多地被用来测量代表性. 最近的应用包括推断公职人员的种族(Lee和Velez, 2025年),以及评估BISG的机器学习变体用于重新分区(Curiel和DeLuca, 2024年)。 同时,预测错误被证明扭曲了依赖这些预测的下游分析(Argyle和Barber,2024;Greenwald等,2024.). 通过为更广泛的群体和设置提供校正概率预测,l\ell BISG扩大了这些应用的范围,同时支持统计上有效的下游推论.

blocks.en: 2 The List-powered BISG Method
blocks.zh: 2 具有清单功能的英国工业与安全研究所 方法

blocks.en: We now introduce our ℓ \ell BISG methodology for obtaining the necessary probabilistic predictions when information about the frequency of names by group is unavailable. In this section, we assume that information about the geographic distribution of the group variable R R is available, meaning that ℙ ⁡ ( R = r ∣ G = g ) \Pr(R=r\mid G=g) are known from census data or have been estimated from surveys for each geography g g (see Section 3 for an extension to the setting in which such information is unavailable or available only for coarser groups).
blocks.zh: 我们现在采用BISG方法,以便在无法获得按组别分列的名称频率信息时,获得必要的概率预测。 在本节中,我们假设关于组变量R的地理分布的信息是可获得的,也就是说,P-(R=r = ∣ G= g)\Pr(R=r\mid G=g)是从人口普查数据中得知的,或是从每个地理g的调查中估计的(关于这种信息无法获取或只能用于较近群体的情况,见第3节)。

blocks.en:
However, for surnames, we only suppose that for each group r r , we have a list of names that are distinctive, common, or typical of that group. These lists may even have some names in common, though more overlap will make groups less distinguishable. In some cases, one group may represent a residual or “other” group not of interest for analysis. Although helpful to have a list for this group if possible, it will not be strictly necessary for ℓ \ell BISG. blocks.en: 2.1 The value of probabilistic prediction in downstream analysis
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 下游分析中概率预测的价值

blocks.en:
Before introducing ℓ \ell BISG, we briefly explain why probabilistic prediction of an individual’s race is essential for valid statistical estimation of racial disparities.
Suppose we observe a random sample of n n individuals from a population. For each individual, we observe their geographic location G i ∈ 𝒢 G_{i}\in\mathcal{G} , name S i ∈ 𝒮 S_{i}\in\mathcal{S} (a first name, surname, or both), and outcome Y i ∈ 𝒴 Y_{i}\in\mathcal{Y} , but not their membership R i ∈ ℛ R_{i}\in\mathcal{R} in a racial, ethnic, or other group of interest. Let d 𝒢 := | 𝒢 | d_{\mathcal{G}}:=|\mathcal{G}| , d 𝒮 := | 𝒮 | d_{\mathcal{S}}:=|\mathcal{S}| , and d ℛ := | ℛ | d_{\mathcal{R}}:=|\mathcal{R}| denote the numbers of possible values of these variables in the population, and assume each is finite. Our objective is to predict R i R_{i} from each individual’s name S i S_{i} and geographic location G i G_{i} , and then use these probabilistic predictions to estimate quantities such as disparities in the outcome Y Y across groups.
blocks.zh:
在介绍我/ell BISG之前,我们简要解释为什么对个人种族的概率预测对于对种族差异的有效统计估计至关重要。
假设我们从一个人群中 随机抽样 对于每个个人,我们观察他们的地理位置 G i _{ G_{i}\in\ mathcal{G}, 名字 S_{i}\i}\in\mathcal{S}(一个名字,姓氏,或两者兼有), 以及结果 Y i ∈i}\i}\in\mathcal{Y}, 但不是他们的成员 R i ∈i}\i}\in\mathcal{R} 在种族,民族或其他利益群体中。 让 d G : = | G | d _{\ mathcal{ }}: =|\ mathcal{ }|, d S : = S | mathcal{ }} S}}: =|\ mathcal{ s}|; d R: = R | mathcal{ R}}: =|\ mathcal{ R}| }| }| }|)表示这些变量在人群中可能存在的数值数量,并假设每个变量都是有限度的. 我们的目标是从每个人的名字S i S i i i i 和地理位置 G i G i i i i 来预测 R i R i i i i ,然后用这些概率预测来估计结果 Y 中不同组别的差异等数量.

blocks.en: A common approach is to assign each individual to the group with the highest predicted probability based on their name and geographic location. However, this hard classification ignores classification error and can bias downstream analyses. To illustrate, consider the case in which both R R and Y Y are binary. Suppose each individual is assigned to the racial group with the highest probability, i.e., R ∗ = arg ​ max r ∈ { 0 , 1 } ​ ℙ ​ ( R = r ∣ S , G ) . R^{*}=\argmax_{r\in\{0,1\}}\Pr(R=r\mid S,G). We refer to this as the oracle classifier because it assumes the true conditional probabilities are known, thereby eliminating estimation error and model misspecification.
blocks.zh: 一种共同做法是,根据个人名称和地理位置,将每个个人指定为预测概率最高的群体。 然而,这种硬分类忽略了分类错误,可能偏向下游分析. 为说明问题,请考虑R R和Y均为二进制的情况。 假设每个个体被分配到概率最高的种族群体,即R * = arg max r { 0, 1} P (R = r ∣ S, G.). (原始内容存档于2018-09-29) (中文(中国大陆) ). R^{*}=\argmax_{r\in\{0, 1\}}\Pr (R=r\mid S,G). 我们将此称为甲骨文分类器,因为它假设真正有条件的概率是已知的,从而消除了估计误差和模型误用.

blocks.en:
Now, suppose the outcome is independent of name conditional on race and geography, Y ⟂ ⁣ ⟂ S | R , G Y\mathbin{\perp\!\!\!\!\!\>\perp}S\mid R,G , which is a key identification assumption for downstream analyses of racial disparities ( McCartan et al., 2025 , see) .
Appendix A1 shows that if we estimate the racial disparity in geography G = g G=g using the oracle classification R ∗ R^{*} , the resulting bias is given by, [ ℙ ⁡ ( Y = y ∣ R ∗ = 1 , g ) − ℙ ⁡ ( Y = y ∣ R ∗ = 0 , g ) ] − [ ℙ ⁡ ( Y = y ∣ R = 1 , g ) − ℙ ⁡ ( Y = y ∣ R = 0 , g ) ] \displaystyle[\Pr(Y=y\mid R^{*}=1,g)-\Pr(Y=y\mid R^{*}=0,g)]-[\Pr(Y=y\mid R=1,g)-\Pr(Y=y\mid R=0,g)] = \displaystyle= − [ ℙ ( Y = y ∣ R = 1 , g ) − ℙ ( Y = y ∣ R = 0 , g ) ] × [ ℙ ( R = 1 ∣ S ∈ 𝒞 0 ​ g , g ) + ℙ ( R = 0 ∣ S ∈ 𝒞 1 ​ g , g ) ] , \displaystyle-[\Pr(Y=y\mid R=1,g)-\Pr(Y=y\mid R=0,g)]\times[\Pr(R=1\mid S\in\mathcal{C}_{0g},g)+\Pr(R=0\mid S\in\mathcal{C}_{1g},g)], where 𝒞 r ​ g \mathcal{C}_{rg} denotes the set of names classified as R ∗ = r R^{*}=r in geography g g . Related results appear in Chen et al. (2019) and Xin et al. (2026) .

The bias in each geography is therefore proportional to the total misclassification rate and has the opposite sign of the true racial disparity. Consequently, hard classification systematically attenuates the estimated disparity toward zero: if the true racial disparity is positive, it is underestimated, whereas if it is negative, it is overestimated. Moreover, the bias is zero if and only if the classification is perfect or the true racial disparity is zero.
blocks.zh: 因此,每种地理的偏差都与总的错分类率成正比,并有相反的种族差异迹象. 因此,硬分类系统缩小了估计的零差距:如果真正的种族差距是正的,就会被低估;如果是负的,就会被高估。 此外,如果并且只有在分类是完美的或者真正的种族差异是零的情况下,偏见是零的.

blocks.en: Empirically, we find that the misclassification rate can be sizable. For a brief illustration, we use the Florida voter file from Section 5.1 , which contains self-reported race. We compute standard BISG probabilities ℙ ⁡ ( R ∣ S , G ) \Pr(R\mid S,G) for every voter using the Census surname table and the block-level race shares. We estimate the racial composition of the electorate by assigning each registrant to their single most likely race and summing across individuals.
blocks.zh: 从经验上讲,我们发现错误的分类率可能相当可观。 简而言之,我们用的是佛罗里达州选民档案 第5.1节,其中载有自报的种族。 我们为每个使用人口普查姓氏表和区块级种族份额的选民计算标准BISG概率(R ∣ S, G)\Pr(R\mid S, G). 我们估计选民的种族组成,将每个登记人分配到他们最有可能的单一种族,并在个人之间进行相互交流。

blocks.en: Compared to the self-reported population composition, the hard classification over-predicts the White share by 5.8 5.8 percentage points (ppts) and under-predicts the Black share by 2.2 2.2 ppts. Using the average estimated probability instead of the hard classifications reduces these errors to − 1.4 -1.4 and − 0.8 -0.8 ppts, respectively, and also causes the mean absolute error of the estimated racial composition, averaged over all five categories, to drop from 2.3 2.3 to 1.0 1.0 ppts.
blocks.zh: 与自报的人口构成相比,硬分类过度预估了"白"的比重为5.8个百分点(ppts),"黑"的比重为2.2 2.2 ppt. 采用平均估计概率而不是硬分类法,将这些错误分别减少到-1.4-1.4和-0.8-0.8ppt,还造成所有五个类别种族组成估计数的平均绝对误差从2.3 2.3降至1.0 ppt。

blocks.en: For downstream estimation, McCartan et al. (2025) proposes the BIRDiE framework, showing that if the outcome is conditionally independent of name given race and geography (i.e., Y ⟂ ⁣ ⟂ S | R , G Y\mathbin{\perp\!\!\!\!\!\>\perp}S\mid R,G ), racial disparities can be estimated without bias using calibrated racial probabilities, ℙ ⁡ ( R = r ∣ S , G ) \Pr(R=r\mid S,G) , rather than imputing race through classification. This assumption is often more credible than the assumption required by the standard weighting approach, which assumes that race is conditionally independent of the outcome given name and geography (i.e., Y ⟂ ⁣ ⟂ R | S , G Y\mathbin{\perp\!\!\!\!\!\>\perp}R\mid S,G ) (see McCartan et al., 2025 , for details) . Under either assumption, accurate estimation of calibrated race probabilities is essential for racial disparity analysis. In our empirical validations (Section 5 ), we use the BIRDiE approach with ℓ \ell BISG probabilities.
blocks.zh: 对于下游估计,McCartan等(2025年)提出了BIRDIE框架,显示如果结果有条件地独立于给定的种族和地理学(即:Y ⟂ ⁣ S | R;G Y\ mathbin {\ p\!!!!!!!;S\ mid R,G!),种族差距可以通过校正的种族概率来进行不偏差估计,P  (R = r∣ S,G;)\Pr (R = mid S,G),而不是通过分类来估计种族. 这个假设往往比标准加权法要求的假设更可信,该假设假设种族在条件上独立于给定的名称和地理结果(即:Y Q⁣R|S;G\mathbin{\perp\!!!!!!!!\>\!R\mid S,G!)(详见McCartan等,2025年). 在这两种假设下,准确估计经过校准的种族概率对种族差异分析至关重要。 在我们的经验验证中(第5节),我们使用BIRDIE方法,其概率为l\ell BISG.

blocks.en: 2.2 Using name embeddings for proxy prediction
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 使用名称嵌入进行代理预测

blocks.en: Name lists contain information about the underlying patterns and structures associated with names from a particular group. For example, lists could suggest that surnames ending in “dez” are often Hispanic, whereas names starting with “zh” are more likely to be Chinese. Such regularities imply that names not appearing on a group-specific list but sharing similar structural or linguistic characteristics may also be associated with that group.
blocks.zh: 姓名清单载有与特定群体姓名有关的基本模式和结构的资料。 例如,名单可能表明,以“dez”结尾的姓氏往往是西班牙语,而以“zh”开头的姓氏更可能是中文。 这种规律性意味着,不出现在特定群体清单上但具有类似结构或语言特征的名字也可能与该群体有关。

blocks.en: Dense text embeddings provide a natural way to formalize these intuitions mathematically and at scale. They represent names as vectors in a high-dimensional space, placing structurally, linguistically, or otherwise similar names closer together based on patterns learned from the corpora used to train the embedding model ( Ye et al., 2017 ; Ye and Skiena, 2019 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . As a result, the embeddings derived from a group-specific name list encode information about the similarity among names both on and off the list, allowing us to identify names that are likely to belong to the same group even if they do not explicitly appear in the original list.
blocks.zh: 深色文本嵌入提供了一种自然的方法,使这些直觉在数学上和规模上正式化. 它们代表了高维空间中作为矢量的命名,在结构上,语言上,或以其他相近的命名方式,根据从培养嵌入模型的蝎子所学出的模式更紧密地结合在一起(Ye等,2017;Ye和斯基埃纳,2019;Wang等,2024.). 因此,从一个特定团体名称列表中衍生出来的关于名字在列表上和列表外的相似性的信息,使我们能够识别可能属于同一团体的名字,即使这些名字没有明确出现在原始列表中.

blocks.en: Suppose that for each name S S , we obtain a d ℰ d_{\mathcal{E}} -dimensional text embedding vector E = E ⁡ ( S ) E=E(S) that captures its linguistic and structural features. Dasanaike and Imai (2026) demonstrates the value of an embedding-based BISG approach (eBISG), which uses Census name tables to learn ℙ ⁡ ( R = r ∣ E , G ) \Pr(R=r\mid E,G) and generalizes the resulting model to rare names whose frequencies are unavailable.
blocks.zh: 假设每个名称 S , 我们得到 d E d_{\mathcal{ E}}-维文本嵌入向量 E = E  (S) E = E (S) , 以捕捉其语言和结构特征. Dasanaike和Imai(2026年)演示了基于嵌入式的BISG方法(eBISG)的价值,该方法使用人口普查名称表来学习P-Q(R=r ∣ E,G)\Pr(R=r\mid E,G),并将所生成的模型概括为频率不通的稀有名称.

blocks.en:
In our setting, however, no such name–group frequency data are available. Instead, we formulate a new proxy prediction task. For each group-specific name list, represented by the indicator L r L_{r} , we model the probability that a name with embedding E E belongs to the list. Although list membership given name is deterministic (i.e., L r ∈ { 0 , 1 } L_{r}\in\{0,1\} ), the conditional probability of list membership given its embedding, ℙ ⁡ ( L r = 1 ∣ E , G ) \Pr(L_{r}=1\mid E,G) , which we call the list score ,
is generally nontrivial. We therefore estimate this mapping from embeddings to the probability of list membership using standard supervised machine learning methods.
blocks.zh:
然而,在我们的设定中,没有这种名称-组频率数据。 相反,我们制定了新的代理预测任务。 对于以L r L_{r}为代表的每个特定组名列表,我们模拟一个带有嵌入 E E 的名称属于列表的概率. 虽然给定名字的列表成员是决定性的(即L r ∈ { 0, 1} L_{r}\in\{0, 1\}}),但由于其嵌入,列表成员的有条件概率为P  (L r = 1  E, G)\Pr (L_{r}= 1\mid E, G),我们称之为列表分数,
一般是非部落性的。 因此,我们估计,这种绘图从嵌入到使用标准监督机器学习方法加入名单的可能性。

blocks.en: Unfortunately, this proxy prediction task does not directly recover the target probabilities ℙ ⁡ ( R = r ∣ E , G ) \Pr(R=r\mid E,G) . Although ℙ ⁡ ( L r = 1 ∣ E , G ) \Pr(L_{r}=1\mid E,G) is generally positively associated with ℙ ⁡ ( R = r ∣ E , G ) \Pr(R=r\mid E,G) , the two quantities are not equal. In Appendix A2 , we show that this list score is not well calibrated, which means it is likely to yield biased downstream estimates. To address this issue, we next show how to recover the target probabilities from the proxy predictions.
blocks.zh: 不幸的是,这一代理预测任务并没有直接恢复目标概率PQ(R=r ∣ E,G)\Pr(R=r\mid E,G). 虽然PQ(Lr = 1∣ E,G)\Pr(L_{r}= 1\mid E,G)一般与PQ(R=r∣ E,G)\Pr(R=r\mid E,G)有正比关系,但这两个量并不相等. 在附录A2中,我们显示这一列表分数的校正不完善,这意味着它很可能会产生偏颇的下游估计. 为了解决这个问题,我们接下来将展示如何从代理预测中恢复目标概率.

blocks.en: Intuitively, B B is obtained by clustering or otherwise reducing the dimension of E E while retaining information relevant for predicting the target group. Because B B is a deterministic many-to-one function of E E , Assumption 2.4 is weaker than the eBISG assumption (Assumption 2.2 ), and therefore also weaker than the classic BISG assumption (Assumption 2.1 ).

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 ℓ \ell BISG
blocks.zh: 算法 1 l\ell BISG

blocks.en: We formally present the ℓ \ell BISG method in Algorithm 1 . When fitting the list membership prediction models in Step 4, we randomly split names into folds and use out-of-sample list scores for each name to reduce overfitting on training names. In our applications, we fit these models using neural networks, for which we choose the number of training epochs by cross-validation within the training data before fitting each model to all the training data.
blocks.zh: 我们用算法正式介绍 I\ell BISG 方法 1 (英语). 当在第4步中安装名单成员预测模型时,我们随机地将名字分成折叠并使用每个名字的外表列表分数来减少训练名称的过度匹配. 在我们的应用中,我们使用神经网络来适应这些模型,我们通过在培训数据中进行交叉验证来选择培训时代的数量,然后将每个模型与所有的培训数据相匹配。

blocks.en: 2.5 Choosing the number of clusters
blocks.zh: 2.5 国家 选择组数

blocks.en: We choose the number of clusters K K to make B B as informative about R R as possible without overfitting: too few clusters leave B B unable to isolate less common groups, whereas too many clusters introduce sparsity, such that ℙ ⁡ ( B ∣ R ) \Pr(B\mid R) cannot be estimated reliably. Unfortunately, because clustering is not supervised by R R , we cannot select K K by held-out accuracy in the usual way. Instead, we select K K by how much geography improves the prediction of clusters in held-out geographic units relative to the overall cluster base rate. This relies on the fact that, under the ℓ \ell BISG assumptions of Section 2.4 , ℙ ⁡ ( B ∣ G ) \Pr(B\mid G) and ℙ ⁡ ( R ∣ G ) \Pr(R\mid G) co-vary across geography (see equation ( 5 )).

Algorithm 2 summarizes our selection procedure.
We use grouped cross-validation, partitioning the geographic units into J ≥ 3 J\geq 3 folds with approximately equal sample sizes. For each fold j j , we use the observations in the remaining J − 1 J-1 folds to construct the clusters following Step 7 of Algorithm 1 and then to estimate ℙ ⁡ ( B ∣ R ) \Pr(B\mid R) through the regression in Steps 8–9 applied just to the training folds. For each observation i i in held-out fold j j , we then compute two out-of-sample probabilities for its assigned cluster B i B_{i} . The first, ℙ ^ ( − j ) ​ ( B = B i ∣ G = G i ) \widehat{\Pr}^{(-j)}(B=B_{i}\mid G=G_{i}) , is the estimated probability of that cluster conditional on the geographic unit containing observation i i . Note that this estimate is the fitted value from the regression, not a direct proportion (see Step 5). The second, ℙ ^ ( − j ) ​ ( B = B i ) \widehat{\Pr}^{(-j)}(B=B_{i}) , is the proportion of observations in the other J − 1 J-1 folds assigned to the same cluster.

blocks.en: As formalized by Q ⁡ ( K ) Q(K) in equation ( 6 ) of Algorithm 2 , our criterion for selecting K K is the difference between the multinomial log-likelihood based on the estimated conditional probabilities, ℙ ^ ( − j ) ​ ( B = B i ∣ G = G i ) \widehat{\Pr}^{(-j)}(B=B_{i}\mid G=G_{i}) , and the corresponding log-likelihood based on the estimated marginal probabilities, ℙ ^ ( − j ) ​ ( B = B i ) \widehat{\Pr}^{(-j)}(B=B_{i}) . Maximizing the conditional log-likelihood alone is unsuitable because prediction is generally easier with fewer clusters, causing the criterion to favor small values of K K . The marginal probability also captures this tendency, so comparing the two cancels it, isolating the added predictive value of geography coming from R R ’s relationship to both G G and B B .

blocks.en: In other words, because ℙ ⁡ ( B ∣ G ) \Pr(B\mid G) depends on ℙ ⁡ ( R ∣ G ) \Pr(R\mid G) and ℙ ⁡ ( B ∣ R ) \Pr(B\mid R) , the difference in log-likelihoods tends to be larger when the cluster variable B B contains more information about R R . If K K is too large, however, the clusters become too sparse to estimate ℙ ⁡ ( B ∣ R ) \Pr(B\mid R) reliably relative to ℙ ⁡ ( B ) \Pr(B) . Selecting the value of K K that maximizes Q ⁡ ( K ) Q(K) therefore balances informativeness against estimation instability. Appendix A4 demonstrates that this selection procedure performs well in the Florida voter-file analysis.

blocks.en: 2.6 Incorporating multiple name lists for each group
blocks.zh: 2.6 国家 包含每个组的多个名称列表

blocks.en: The ℓ \ell BISG framework naturally accommodates multiple name lists (e.g., first-name and surname lists) for each group. Let E F E_{F} and E S E_{S} denote the first-name and surname embeddings, respectively. Applying ℓ \ell BISG separately to each field yields the calibrated probabilities ℙ ⁡ ( R ∣ B F , G ) \Pr(R\mid B_{F},G) and ℙ ⁡ ( R ∣ B S , G ) \Pr(R\mid B_{S},G) , where B F B_{F} and B S B_{S} denote the first-name and surname clusters.

blocks.en: 2.7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 2.7 讨论情况

blocks.en: We emphasize that throughout, ℓ \ell BISG imposes no assumptions on the quality of the list or the ranking. Indeed, when compared to the standard BISG method, the only additional assumption required for ℓ \ell BISG is Assumption 2.3 , which is typically satisfied if there is some geographic variation in group prevalence. The caveat is that only good lists are able to improve upon the geographic baseline ℙ ⁡ ( R = 1 ∣ G ) \Pr(R=1\mid G) .
blocks.zh: 我们强调,在整个过程中,我对清单的质量或排名不作任何假设。 的确,与标准的BISG方法相比,l\ellBISG所需的唯一附加假设是假设2.3.,如果群体流行率在地理上存在一些差异,通常会满足这一假设. 警告是,只有好的列表才能在地理基线P = (R = 1 = = G)\ Pr(R = 1\ mid G)的基础上改进.

blocks.en: In the ℓ \ell BISG algorithm, one could even cluster directly on embeddings E E without using name lists – ℓ \ell BISG might then stand for “low-dimensional embedding powered BISG.” However, such an unsupervised approach relies upon the embeddings being primarily an encoding of group membership so that they are spatially separated in ℝ d ℰ \mathbb{R}^{d_{\mathcal{E}}} into clusters that correspond to the group of interest. By comparison, the proposed semi-supervised approach first projects the embeddings to a lower-dimensional metric specifically constructed for the group prediction task. Neither approach produces clusters with known labels, but the list-based clusters tend to construct more informative clusters. Note that in Section 3 below, where the geographic prevalence of different groups must be recovered, the name lists are required.
blocks.zh: 在 l\ell BISG 算法中,人们甚至可以直接集群嵌入 E E 而不使用名称列表 — — I\ell BISG 然后可能代表“低维嵌入有动力的 BISG ” 。 然而,这种不受监督的方法依赖于嵌入物主要是集团成员的编码,从而在R d E\mathbb{R}^{d_{\mathcal{E}}}]空间上将它们分离成与利益集团相适应的集群. 相比之下,拟议的半监督方法首先将嵌入到一个为小组预测任务专门构建的下维度量度中。 这两种方法都产生有已知标签的集群,但基于列表的集群往往会构建更丰富的集群. 请注意,在下文第3节中,如果必须恢复不同群体的地域分布,则需要名单。

blocks.en: Empirically, we find that the lists sometimes carry important information that can improve on clustering alone. For example, in the Florida voter file application presented in Section 5.1 , clustering on the list scores rather than on the raw embeddings raises the average precision for the rare Asian group from 0.15 0.15 to 0.25 0.25 at K = 500 K=500 . The two approaches perform similarly for the other groups and at the larger number of clusters that Algorithm 2 selects in the full sample (see Appendix A5 ). The same result extends to the Lebanese voter file in Section 5.3 , where clustering on the list scores rather than the raw embeddings raises the average precision for the Armenian Orthodox, the smallest sect, from 0.64 0.64 to 0.69 0.69 at K = 100 K=100 . These two results suggest that lists may be especially useful for smaller groups that fully unsupervised clustering struggles to identify.
blocks.zh: 从经验上讲,我们发现,这些清单有时载有重要的信息,可以单独改进分组。 例如,在第5.1节所介绍的佛罗里达州选民档案申请中,在列表分数上分组,而不是在原始嵌入上分组,将稀有亚洲组的平均精度从0.15 0.15提高到0.25 0.25 在K=500 K=500时. 这两种方法对于其他组别以及算法2在全部样本中选择的更多组别(见附录A5)。 同样的结果是第5.3节中的黎巴嫩选民档案,在名单分数中分组而不是原始嵌入,使最小的教派亚美尼亚东正教的平均精确度从0.64 0.64提高到0.69 0.69,以K=100 K=100。 这两个结果表明,清单可能对完全不受监督的集群斗争难以确定的较小群体特别有用。

blocks.en: The clustering step of ℓ \ell BISG can also be viewed as using the embeddings to update and extend our original lists. For example, if Hernandez originally appeared on the Hispanic list and Fernandez did not, their closeness in embedding space hopefully will mean that Fernandez is also included in the Hispanic cluster. In this way, we generalize initial, possibly quite small, lists to the entire embedding space.
blocks.zh: I\ell BISG 的分组步骤也可以被视为使用嵌入来更新和扩展我们的原始列表. 例如,如果赫尔南德斯最初出现在西班牙语列表上,而费尔南德斯没有出现,那么他们在嵌入空间中的亲切性有望意味着费尔南德斯也被列入了西班牙语集群. 这样,我们将初始的,可能相当小的列表概括到整个嵌入空间.

blocks.en: Finally, researchers often have lists for only a few groups of interest rather than a full partition of the population. Because the subgroup probabilities sum to one, it is sufficient to estimate them for the d ℛ − 1 d_{\mathcal{R}}-1 named groups, leaving a residual class as the complement. That said, forming an explicit residual list for that class, for example by gathering names distinctive of the overall population but not of any group of interest, can be worthwhile. In Section 3 , we show that the provision of such a name list becomes necessary once geographic prevalence must be recovered rather than assumed known.
blocks.zh: 最后,研究人员往往只列出少数利益群体名单,而不是完全分割人口。 由于子组概率相加为一,因此可以对dR− 1 d_{\mathcal{R}}-1命名组进行估计,留下一个剩余类作为补充. 尽管如此,为这一类人制定明确的剩余名单,例如收集与总人口不同但没有任何利益群体的名字,是值得的。 在第3节中,我们表明,一旦必须恢复而不是假定已知的地理流行率,就有必要提供这种姓名清单。

blocks.en: Another advantage of ℓ \ell BISG is that it naturally accommodates overlapping name lists, in which the same name appears on multiple lists. Specifically, each probability ℙ ⁡ ( L r ∣ E = e ) \Pr(L_{r}\mid E=e) is estimated as a separate prediction task, which treats each name separately for each target group. Consequently, a name appearing on multiple lists simply receives a high list score for each corresponding task, and this may be reflected in the clustering, which is performed on a function of the full vector of list scores, 𝒇 ^ e \hat{\bm{f}}_{e} . Although overlap makes the target groups less distinguishable, it does not otherwise affect the validity of the method.
blocks.zh: l\ell BISG的另一个优点是它自然地容纳了相重叠的名字列表,在多个列表中会出现同名. 具体来说,每个概率P-(L r ∣ E = e)\Pr(L_{r}\mid E = e)作为一个单独的预测任务来估计,它分别处理每个目标群体的每个名称. 因此,在多个列表中出现的名字只是每个相应任务都得到高列表分数,这可能会被反映在分组中,该分组是在列表分数的全向量函数 f^ e\ hat\bm{ f} 上进行. 虽然重叠使目标群体难以区分,但并不影响方法的有效性。

blocks.en: 3 Recovering Geographic Prevalence
blocks.zh: 3 恢复地理流行率

blocks.en: The ℓ \ell BISG method developed in Section 2 assumes access to group geographic prevalence rates ℙ ⁡ ( R = r ∣ G ) \Pr(R=r\mid G) . In this section, we propose methods for recovering geographic prevalence when it is either entirely unavailable (Section 3.2 ) or only available for coarse groups relative to finer subgroups of interest (Section 3.3 ). Compared to the previous section, in these settings, the name lists are necessary because we recover group geographic prevalence from the rates at which people in a given geographic unit have surnames on each list.
blocks.zh: 第2节中开发的l-ell BISG方法假定可获得群体地域流行率P-(R=r-Q-G)\Pr(R=r-mid G). 在本节中,我们建议了在完全不存在(第3.2节)或仅针对较粗细的利益分组(第3.3节)的粗人群体时恢复地域流行率的方法。 与上一节相比,在这些背景下,名字表是必要的,因为我们从某一地域单位的人在每个名单上的姓氏比例中恢复了群体地域普及率。

blocks.en: Because these settings assume less available data, they also require additional assumptions to make progress. Unlike the preceding application of ℓ \ell BISG, the methods in this section require (1) that lists lack any geographic selection bias and (2) that there is perfect separation across group name lists: no member of one subgroup may have a name on another group’s list. Under this additional assumption, we can first recover geographic probabilities and then apply the ℓ \ell BISG method described in Section 2 .
blocks.zh: 由于这些设置假设可获得的数据较少,它们也需要额外的假设才能取得进展. 与之前的l\ell BISG应用不同,本节的方法要求(1)列表缺乏任何地域选择偏差和(2)在群体名称列表之间完美分离:一个分组的成员不得在另一个分组的列表上有名称. 根据这一附加假设,我们可以首先恢复地理概率,然后适用第2节所描述的l-ell BISG方法。

blocks.en: The assumption of perfect separation means that the method introduced in this section is applicable only to subgroups whose names are distinct from one another. In Appendix A6 , we develop sensitivity analysis tools for relaxing the perfect-separation assumption and assessing how this affects the empirical results. However, we recommend using these sensitivity analyses only when the expected violations are fairly small and homogeneous across groups.
blocks.zh: 完全分离的假设意味着本节中引入的方法只适用于其名称彼此不同的分组. 在附录A6中,我们开发了敏感度分析工具来放松完美分离假设并评估这如何影响实证结果. 然而,我们建议,只有当预期的侵权行为相当小,而且各群体之间相当一致时,才使用这些敏感性分析。

blocks.en: 3.1 List construction must not depend on geography
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 列表构建不能取决于地理

blocks.en: Our first additional assumption is that conditional on group membership, list membership is independent of geography.
blocks.zh: 我们的第一个额外假设是,以集团成员为条件,名单成员独立于地理。

For example, suppose a list is compiled from a geographically unrepresentative source, such as the membership rolls of a regional organization. blocks.zh: 3.2 拟议的解决办法在集团名称名单中完美分开

blocks.en: The within-group and across-group list membership rates ℙ ⁡ ( L r ′ = 1 ∣ R = r ) \Pr(L_{r^{\prime}}=1\mid R=r) reflect how well the lists separate the groups. When r ≠ r ′ r\neq r^{\prime} , a positive cross-group-rate indicates that there are members of one group r r whose names appear on the list for another group r ′ r^{\prime} . This can happen for two reasons: (1) poor list quality and (2) inherent lack of group separation by names. For example, if trying to separate English and Irish groups, positive cross-group-rates could be caused by using too-expansive lists not designed for the purpose of separating these groups. At the same time, historical and linguistic ties between the two groups may also make these groups inherently difficult to separate.

blocks.en: 3.3 Extension to the subgroup problem
blocks.zh: 3.3 分组问题的延伸

blocks.en: We next consider another common but challenging setting, in which geographic prevalence data are not available for groups of interest, but such information does exist for coarser groups. For example, the U.S. Census provides geographic prevalence for the broad Asian category but not for finer subgroups such as Chinese, Korean, Japanese, or South Asian. This again creates a barrier to directly applying the ℓ \ell BISG method of Section 2 with higher-resolution name lists, but we can leverage the coarser information in a way that generalizes the method and assumptions described above.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来考虑另一个共同但具有挑战性的环境,即没有利益集团的地理流行率数据,但此类信息确实存在于较粗小的群体。 例如,美国人口普查提供了亚洲大类的地理流行率,但没有为中国人、朝鲜人、日本人或南亚人等较细的分组提供地理流行率。 这再次为直接应用有更高分辨率名称列表的第2节的l\ell BISG方法制造了障碍,但是我们可以以概括上述方法和假设的方式来利用相干信息.

blocks.en: 3.4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 3.4 讨论情况

blocks.en: The case where geographic information is missing represents a common but difficult problem. In such situations, high-quality name lists become not just a useful tool for better clustering of names but essential for being able to identify meaningful probabilities at all. The key intuition is that high-quality lists which are not geographically skewed contain some information about the geographic distribution of their members. For well-separated groups with high-quality lists, the above method allows us to recover ℙ ⁡ ( R = r ∣ G ) \Pr(R=r\mid G) even when there is no prior geographic information at all. When subgroups are of interest, and yet only the geographic prevalence of a coarse group is available, high-quality lists allow us to recover subgroup geographic prevalence as well. Once recovered, these estimates of geographic prevalence can be used by applying the ℓ \ell BISG method of Section 2 to again obtain the target posterior probabilities.
blocks.zh: 地理信息缺失是一个常见而困难的问题。 在这种情况下,高质量的姓名清单不仅成为更好地分类的有用工具,而且对于能够确定有意义的概率至关重要。 主要的直觉是,在地理上没有扭曲的高质量名单中包含一些关于其成员地理分布的信息。 对于有高质量列表的分隔良好的群体,上述方法允许我们回收P QQ(R = r ∣ G)\Pr(R = r\mid G),即使根本没有先前的地理信息. 如果分组感兴趣,但只有粗人群体的地理分布,那么高质量的名单使我们能够恢复分组地域分布。 一旦恢复,这些地理流行率估计数可以通过应用第2节的l\ell BISG方法再次获得目标后概率来使用.

blocks.en:
There may be further ways to weaken some of the assumptions made in this section, especially if more prior information is known about which groups are likely to be poorly separated or at what resolution list geographic selection mechanisms occur. For example,
one way to weaken Assumption 3.1 is to apply it only within a coarser geographic unit (e.g., within each county when the original geographic unit is census tract). In that case, all subsequent steps should be applied separately within each region. However, even if this conditioning means there is no further relationship between list and high-resolution geographic unit, list quality may be poor in regions whose names were originally under-represented, leading to potentially low values of ℙ ⁡ ( L r = 1 ∣ G ) \Pr(L_{r}=1\mid G) or ℙ ⁡ ( L c = 1 ∣ G ) \Pr(L_{c}=1\mid G) and unstable results for those regions. It may then be necessary to try to build separate name lists for each region.
blocks.zh:
可能还有进一步的方法来削弱本节提出的一些假设,特别是如果事先知道更多关于哪些群体可能无法很好地分开的资料,或者在决议清单中有哪些地域选择机制。 譬如说.
削弱Assumption 3.1的一种方法是只在相近的地理单位内(例如,当原始地理单位为普查道时,在每个县内)适用. 在这种情况下,随后的所有步骤都应在各区域内分别适用。 然而,即使这一条件意味着列表和高分辨率地理单位之间没有进一步的关系,在名字最初代表不足的地区,列表质量可能较差,导致PQQ(L r = 1 → G)\Pr(L_{r}=1\mid G)或PQ(L C = 1 → G)的数值可能较低,这些区域的结果不稳定. 因此,也许有必要努力为每个区域分别编制名称清单。

blocks.en: 4 Obtaining and Evaluating Name Lists
blocks.zh: 4 获取和评估名称清单

blocks.en: In this section, we briefly discuss how to obtain and evaluate group-specific name lists.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们简要地讨论了如何获得和评价特定群体的名字清单。

blocks.en: 4.1 Generating name lists
blocks.zh: 4.1 生成名称清单

blocks.en: There are different ways to build name lists. First, lists can be curated from domain knowledge or existing records. For example, they may be constructed from prior surveys, censuses, or genealogical records; membership rolls of group-affiliated organizations; obituaries associated with group-specific funeral homes ( Chasalow et al., 2026 ) ; curated Wikipedia pages ( Chintalapati et al., 2018 ) ; or the activities of identified users on social media ( Wood-Doughty et al., 2018 ) . Curated lists can be highly distinctive, but their coverage depends on the source. Sources tied to a particular place may violate the no-geographic-selection assumption (Assumption 3.1 ) that the geographic prevalence recovery method of Section 3 relies on.
blocks.zh: 建立名字列表有不同的方法. 首先,列表可以从域知识或现有记录中整理出. 例如,它们可能取自先前的调查,人口普查或家族记录;团体附属组织的会员名册;与团体特定殡仪馆相关的讣告(Chasalow等,2026年);被整理的维基百科页面(Chintalapati等,2018年);或被识别用户在社交媒体上的活动(Wood-Doughty等,2018年). 被破解的清单可以高度区别,但其覆盖范围取决于来源. 与某一特定地点相连的资料来源可能违反第3节地域流行率恢复方法所依赖的无地域选择假设(Assumption 3.1)。

blocks.en: A second approach, which makes ℓ \ell BISG applicable even when no frequency table or curated record exists, is to prompt an LLM to generate surnames typical of a target group, thereby leveraging the world knowledge encoded during pre-training ( Dasanaike, 2026 ) . This approach is broadly applicable across many types of groups and targets. Because the model returns the names it judges to be typical, the resulting lists may be common but also include surnames that are not distinctive.
blocks.zh: 第二种方法使l\ell BISG即使在没有频率表或校正记录的情况下也适用,即促使LLM生成典型的目标群体的姓氏,从而利用在预训期间编码的世界知识(Dasanaike, 2026年). 这种办法广泛适用于许多类型的群体和目标。 由于模型返回它判断为典型的名字,因此由此产生的列表可能很常见,但也包括了没有特色的姓氏.

blocks.en: To improve distinctiveness, one can apply a within-group exclusivity filter by removing any surname that appears on more than one group’s list. This is necessary, though not sufficient, for the geographic prevalence recovery method described in Section 3 . In addition, one can prompt an LLM to generate surnames that are distinctively associated with the group of interest. The generated list can then be refined by asking a possibly different model to assess the distinctiveness of each name and retaining only those that are judged to be truly distinctive.
blocks.zh: 为了提高独特性,人们可以使用集团内部的排他性过滤器,删除一个以上集团清单上的任何姓氏。 这对于第3节所描述的地域流行率恢复方法是必要的,但还不够。 此外,人们还可以促使LLM生成与利益集团有明显关联的姓氏. 然后,通过要求一种可能不同的模式来评估每个名称的独特性,并只保留那些被认为真正不同的名字,就可以对生成的清单加以完善。

blocks.en: 4.2 Desirable properties of name lists
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 姓名清单的适当属性

blocks.en: What makes a good name list? Ideally, a name list contains names that are both distinctive and common within the group of interest. Distinctive names have high positive predictive value for the target group (i.e., ℙ ⁡ ( R = r ∣ S = s ) \Pr(R=r\mid S=s) is high), whereas common names are held by a large share of the target group (i.e., ℙ ⁡ ( S = s ∣ R = r ) \Pr(S=s\mid R=r) is high).
blocks.zh: 是什么让一个好的名字列表? 理想的情况是,名称清单中包含的利益集团内部独特而共同的名字。 不同名称对目标群体具有高正预测值(即:P  (R = r = ∣ S = s)\Pr(R = r\mid S = s)),而常见名称则由目标群体的一大部分所持有(即:P⁡ (S = s∣ R = r)\Pr (S = s\mid R = r)).

blocks.en: In addition, a name list should ideally cover different subgroups within the group of interest. For example, a list of Asian names that entirely excludes Japanese names may have distinctive and common names for other subgroups, like Chinese, but not capture the full diversity of the group. If the excluded subgroup is concentrated in particular geographic areas, the list also violates the no-geographic-selection assumption (Assumption 3.1 ) required for the geography prevalence recovery method discussed in Section 3.1 .
blocks.zh: 此外,名字清单最好应涵盖利益集团内的不同分组。 例如,一个完全排除了日本人名字的亚洲人名列表,可能对于其他分组,如汉语,有着有特色和共同的名字,但并不能捕捉到该组的全部多样性. 如果被排除在外的分组集中在特定地理区域,清单也违反了第3.1节所讨论地域流行恢复方法所需的无地域选择假设(假设3.1)。

blocks.en: For illustration, we generate a name list for each of the four racial groups in the Florida voter file analyzed in Section 5.1 using an LLM, Gemini 3.0 Flash. This corresponds to a realistic setting in which researchers must create lists on their own without relying on name frequency tables. To cover the subgroups within each racial group, we use separate prompts for different national origins. For the White list, for instance, we use three prompts, each requesting surnames of individuals with English and Irish descent; German descent; and Italian, Polish, and other European descent. We split Asian into Chinese; Indian; Vietnamese and Filipino; and Korean and Japanese. Appendix A7 provides the exact prompts.
blocks.zh: 为了说明问题,我们用一个LLM,双子座 3.0 Flash来生成佛罗里达州选民档案中分析的四个种族团体的每个名称清单。 这符合现实的设定,在这种设定中,研究人员必须自己创建列表,而无需依赖名称频率表. 为了覆盖每个种族群体内的分组,我们使用不同的民族血统的单独提示。 例如,对于白人名单,我们使用三个音符,每个音符要求有英语和爱尔兰语血统的个人的姓氏;德语血统;以及意大利语、波兰语和其他欧洲血统。 我们把亚洲人分为:中国人;印度人;越南人和菲律宾人;朝鲜人和日本人。 附录A7提供了确切的提示.

blocks.en: For each of these prompts, we make six separate model calls at temperature 1.0 1.0 , and request 300 300 surnames per call. With three prompts each, the White, Black, and Hispanic groups have eighteen calls and 5,400 5{,}400 requested surnames, while the four Asian prompts give a total of 7,200 7{,}200 surnames. Within each group, we pool the results of all calls across prompts, rank the unique surnames by the number of calls that returned them, and then retain the top 1,000 1{,}000 surnames. This means that a surname ranks higher when the language model produces it consistently. Because that score is a count over eighteen calls, or twenty-four for Asian surnames, many surnames are ranked in a tie. Since the top 1,000 threshold often falls inside a tied band, we break those ties by the order in which the model first returned each surname.
blocks.zh: 每一个提示,我们都会在1.01.0温度下发出6个单独的模型呼叫,并且要求每个呼叫300个姓氏. 白人、黑人和西班牙裔各有18个电话和5,400个5{,}400个要求取姓,而亚洲4个电话则总共取了7,200个7{,}200个姓。 在每组中,我们汇集所有调用的结果横跨提示,按照调回的调用次数排列出独有的姓氏,然后保留最高的1000个1{,}000个姓氏. 这意味着在语言模型持续生成时,姓氏排名会更高. 因为这个分数是超过18个电话的倒数,或者亚洲姓氏的倒数是24个,所以许多姓氏的取名顺序都是平分. 由于前1000个阈值经常会落在捆绑的带子内,我们按照模型首次回回每个姓氏的顺序来打破这些联系.

blocks.en: We find that for ℓ \ell BISG on the Florida voter file, the gain in discrimination from longer lists is essentially complete at a few hundred surnames per group (see the top panel of Figure A8 in Appendix A8.2 ). The same analysis on the North Carolina voter file (the bottom panel of the same appendix figure) produces a similar result for the White and Black groups. For the smaller Asian group in North Carolina, however, discrimination continues to improve beyond a few hundred surnames.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,对于我在佛罗里达州选民档案中披露的BISG来说,从较长的名单上获得的歧视收益基本上已经达到每组几百个姓(见附录A8.2图A8的顶部面板)。 北卡罗来纳州选民档案的同名分析(同名附录图的下个面板)对白人和黑人组也得出了类似的结果. 然而,对北卡罗莱纳州较小的亚裔群体来说,歧视继续改善,超过了几百个姓氏。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Florida surnames plotted by log commonness ℙ ⁡ ( S ∣ R ) \Pr(S\mid R) ( x x -axis) against distinctiveness ℙ ⁡ ( R ∣ S ) \Pr(R\mid S) ( y y -axis) for the four race groups. Each point is a surname held by at least twenty-five members of the group, sized by how many voters hold it. Colored points are those included in the list of 1,000 1{,}000 surnames generated by an LLM for that group. Labeled points are the most common surnames in each group. The dashed line marks the distinctiveness floor of 0.3 0.3 used to build lists in Section 5.1 .
blocks.zh: 图1:佛罗里达州的姓氏由log commonness P ⁡ (S ∣ R )\Pr (S\mid R (x-轴))所绘制,以对抗特异性 P ⁡ (R ∣ S )\Pr (R\mid S (y-轴)),用于四个种族组别. 每个点是该团体至少25名成员所持有的姓氏,以选民持有多少为大小. 彩色点是用一个LLM为该组生成的1000 1{,}000个姓氏列表中所包含的点. 标签点是每个组中最常见的姓氏. 破损线标出0.3 0.3的特异性,用于编制第5.1节所列清单。

blocks.en: Figure 1 plots the surnames held by Floridians of each race along distinctiveness ( y y -axis) and commonness ( x x -axis). Each point represents a surname held by at least 25 individuals, and the colored points indicate the surnames included in the LLM-generated list of 1,000 1{,}000 surnames for that group.
blocks.zh: 图1将每个种族的弗洛里德人所持的姓氏按照不同(y-y-轴)和公用(x-轴)排列。 每个点代表至少由25个个人持有的姓氏,有色点表示LLM生成的1000 1{,}000个该组的姓氏列表所包括的姓氏.

blocks.en: The four racial groups exhibit distinct patterns. White surnames span a broad range of both commonness and distinctiveness. Hispanic surnames form a dense band characterized by high distinctiveness and a range of commonness, making them well suited for both identifying and representing the group. Black surnames are generally less distinctive because they are more frequently shared with other groups, in particular white, although there are some quite common names. Asian surnames resemble Hispanic surnames in being both relatively common and highly distinctive, with some exceptions including “Lee,” which is relatively common but not distinctive at all. Overall, the LLM appears to generally select surnames that are both distinctive and common. The exception is Black surnames, for which it prioritizes commonness over distinctiveness.
blocks.zh: 四个种族群体呈现出不同的模式。 白姓既具有共通性又具有特异性。 西班牙裔的姓氏组成了一支密集的乐队,其特征是具有高度的特色和一系列的共通性,使得这些姓氏非常适合识别和代表群体. 黑色姓氏一般不太有区别,因为与其他群体,尤其是白人更经常地共用,尽管有一些相当常见的姓氏. 亚裔姓氏与西班牙裔姓氏相似,既比较常见又具有很强的区别,但有一些例外,包括"Lee",这个姓氏虽然比较常见但完全没有区别. 总的来说,LLM似乎一般地选择了既有特色又常见的姓氏. 例外的是黑色姓氏,对于黑色姓氏,它优先考虑同分性而不是同分性.

blocks.en: Coverage matters for another reason. The embedding step extends the information in a list to unlisted names that are close in embedding space. A list which provides a broader coverage of the group’s name distribution thus yields more accurate probabilities for unlisted names. In Appendix A3 , we visually inspect the coverage of the LLM surname lists of Section 5.1 in the embedding space of the Florida surnames. The high list scores for each group fall in distinct regions of this space, with Hispanic in particular demonstrating strong clustering. These regions include many surnames that are not on any list.
blocks.zh: 覆盖范围有另一个原因。 嵌入步骤将列表中的信息延伸至嵌入空间中相近的未列表名称. 因此,一份清单扩大了该团体名称分布的覆盖面,从而对未列入清单的名称产生更准确的概率。 在附录A3中,我们可视地检查佛罗里达州姓氏嵌入空间中第5.1节LLM姓氏列表的覆盖范围. 每个组的得分高,都落在这个空间的不同区域,特别是西班牙语表现出强烈的集群。 这些地区包括许多不在任何清单上的姓氏.

blocks.en: 4.3 Measure of list quality when geographic prevalence is available
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 在具备地理流行率的情况下衡量清单质量

blocks.en: In the absence of ground-truth data, the relationship between list membership and true group membership cannot be directly measured. However, when geographic prevalence is known, as assumed in Section 2 and lists satisfy Assumption 3.1 of no geographic selection, then it is possible to recover probabilities π r , r ′ := ℙ ⁡ ( L r ′ = 1 ∣ R = r ) \pi_{r,r^{\prime}}:=\Pr(L_{r^{\prime}}=1\mid R=r) using the same strategy as the one used for recovering ℙ ⁡ ( B = b ∣ R = r ) \Pr(B=b\mid R=r) .
blocks.zh: 由于缺乏实地真实数据,无法直接衡量名单成员与真正集团成员之间的关系。 然而,如第2节所假定的,如果已知地域普遍程度,名单满足了无地域选择的假设3.1,那么有可能恢复概率 r,r := P  (L r = 1 ∣ R = r)\pi_{r,r^{\prime}}:=\ Pr (L_{r^{\prime}}= 1\mid R = r)使用与恢复P⁡ (B = b∣ R = r)相同的策略.

blocks.en: Specifically, we solve the following linear system of d 𝒢 ​ d ℛ d_{\mathcal{G}}d_{\mathcal{R}} equations with d ℛ 2 d_{\mathcal{R}}^{2} unknowns, ℙ ⁡ ( L r ′ = 1 ∣ G = g ) = ∑ r = 1 d ℛ π r , r ′ ​ ℙ ⁡ ( R = r ∣ G = g ) . \Pr(L_{r^{\prime}}=1\mid G=g)=\sum_{r=1}^{d_{\mathcal{R}}}\pi_{r,r^{\prime}}\Pr(R=r\mid G=g). (15) This is equivalent to equation ( 8 ) above, but applied in the setting where ℙ ⁡ ( R = r ∣ G = g ) \Pr(R=r\mid G=g) prevalence rates are available. This system again has a unique solution if there is sufficient variation in these rates to satisfy Assumption 2.3 .

blocks.en: 5 Empirical Validation
blocks.zh: 5 经验验证

blocks.en:
We empirically validate ℓ \ell BISG in three diverse settings with known ground truth. First, we use voter files from Florida and North Carolina, where self-reported race is available. We compare the performance of ℓ \ell BISG with that of the standard BISG based on Census name frequency tables. We show that ℓ \ell BISG performs as well as the standard BISG despite not using the name-race frequency data.
Second, we use the full-count 1900 U.S. Census to predict Chinese and Japanese subgroups within the Asian population. This evaluates the performance of the methodological extension proposed in Section 3 when geographic prevalence is not available for subgroups of interest. This analysis also corresponds to a level of granularity for which no name frequency tables naturally exist. Third, we consider the prediction of religious sect in Lebanon, illustrating the applicability of ℓ \ell BISG outside the conventional race-based BISG setting in the United States.
blocks.zh:
我们通过经验验证 I\ell BISG 在三种不同的环境 已知的地面真相。 首先,我们使用佛罗里达州和北卡罗莱纳州的选民档案,那里有自报的种族. 我们比较了l\ellBISG的性能和基于人口普查名称频率表的标准BISG的性能. 我们显示,尽管没有使用名称-种族频率数据,我/ell BISG还是执行标准BISG。
第二,我们用1900年美国人口普查的全数预测亚洲人口中的中国和日本分组. 这评价了第3节提议的方法推广工作在不向感兴趣的分组提供地域普及率的情况下的业绩。 这种分析也对应出一个颗粒分级,对于这个分级,没有自然存在的名称频率表. 第三,我们认为对黎巴嫩宗教教派的预测表明,在传统的基于种族的BISG环境之外,I-ell BISG在美国的适用性。

blocks.en: In each application, we evaluate the calibration of the predicted probabilities, their discriminatory power, and the bias and RMSE of downstream disparity estimates.
blocks.zh: 在每项申请中,我们评估预测概率的校准、其歧视性力量以及下游差异估计的偏差和RMSE。

blocks.en: 5.1 Comparison with standard BISG using US voter files
blocks.zh: 5.1 使用美国选民文件与标准的BISG进行比较

blocks.en: We obtain Florida and North Carolina voter files from L2 Inc., a leading national non-partisan firm and the oldest organization in the United States that supplies voter data and related technology to candidates, political parties, pollsters, and consultants for use in campaigns. These voter files contain the self-reported race of each registrant alongside their geocoded residential address, turnout in recent elections, and political party registration.
blocks.zh: 我们从L2公司获得佛罗里达州和北卡罗来纳州的选民档案。 L2公司是一家全国领先的无党派公司,也是美国历史最悠久的组织,向候选人、政党、选民和顾问提供选民数据和相关技术,供竞选使用。 这些选民档案包括每个登记者的自我报告种族及其地理编码居民地址、最近的选举投票率和政党登记。

blocks.en: We collapse the race field into five categories, White, Black, Hispanic, Asian, and other, the last of which includes American Indian and Alaska Native. We use the Florida file of March 7, 2026 and the North Carolina file of April 11, 2026. We exclude registrants whose race is not recorded in the voter file and those without Census geocodes, comprising 494,443 494{,}443 and 627,520 627{,}520 of Florida’s 15,017,471 15{,}017{,}471 voters and 649,911 649{,}911 and 318,860 318{,}860 of North Carolina’s 7,249,018 7{,}249{,}018 , respectively. Lastly, we draw random samples of one million registrants from the remainder in each state.
blocks.zh: 我们把种族领域分为五类,白人,黑人,西班牙人,亚洲人等,最后一类包括美国印第安人和阿拉斯加原住民. 我们使用佛罗里达州档案2026年3月7日,北卡罗来纳州档案2026年4月11日. 包括494,443,494{,}443和627,520 627{,}520名佛罗里达州的15,017,471 15{,}017{,}471名选民和649,911 649{,}911和318,860 318{,}860名北卡罗来纳州的7,249,018 7{,}249{,}018名选民。 最后,我们从每个州的其余部分抽取100万登记者的随机样本。

blocks.en: We apply ℓ \ell BISG and standard BISG using the published 2020 Census block-level race shares as the geographic priors. For registrants whose blocks have zero population, we use the tract prior instead. 1 1 1 These blocks have zero population in the Census table partly because of the noise the Census Bureau adds to block counts to protect privacy. This accounts for 1.1 % 1.1\% of the Florida sample and 0.9 % 0.9\% of the North Carolina sample. We use the county prior for registrants whose blocks are absent from the Census table, totaling 0.02 % 0.02\% of the Florida sample and 0.13 % 0.13\% of the North Carolina sample. In the downstream analysis, we use these predictions to estimate the Democratic share of each racial group aggregated at the county level, based on party registration.
blocks.zh: 我们使用已公布的2020年人口普查区块级种族份额作为地理前置份额来应用l\ell BISG和标准BISG. 对于区块组分为零的登记者,我们使用前面的道。 1个 1 这些区块在人口普查表中没有人口,部分原因是人口普查局为保护隐私而在区块计数中增加了噪音。 这占了佛罗里达州样本的1.1% 1.1% 和北卡罗莱纳州样本的0.9%. 我们使用县前的登记者 他们的区块不在人口普查表, 总计0.02%的佛罗里达州样本 和0.13%的北卡罗莱纳州样本。 在下游分析中,我们利用这些预测,根据政党登记,估计每个种族群体在县一级所占的民主份额。

blocks.en: To estimate the individual race probabilities using ℓ \ell BISG, we draw on two sets of name lists in turn. The first name list is an oracle one based on the 2020 Census surname table, which reports the racial composition of every surname occurring at least 100 100 times in the Census. Admittedly, the ℓ \ell BISG method is targeted at applications where such tables are not available. However, because this list is directly derived from the Census data, it allows us to evaluate the consequences of losing frequency information on the quality of individual race probability estimates and downstream analysis by comparing the resulting estimates with those based on the standard surname-table-based BISG.
blocks.zh: 为了使用l\ell BISG来估计个人的种族概率,我们依次取出两套名字列表. 首个姓氏列表是基于2020年人口普查姓氏表的神谕,该表报告每个姓氏的种族构成在人口普查中至少发生100回. 诚然,I\ell BISG方法针对没有这种表格的应用程序。 然而,由于此列表直接取自人口普查数据,因此通过将所得出的估计数同基于标准姓氏表的BISG的估计数进行比较,我们得以评价丢失有关个人种族概率估计质量的频率信息所造成的后果和下游分析.

blocks.en: As described in Section 4.2 , a useful list has names that are sufficiently common and yet distinctive, with clear group membership. For each group r r , we construct the corresponding Census list by filtering to surnames that are at least 30 % 30\% likely to belong to that group, i.e., ℙ ⁡ ( R = r ∣ S = s ) ≥ 0.30 \Pr(R=r\mid S=s)\geq 0.30 . 2 2 2 We set the floor at 0.30 0.30 because it is a smallest value at which the four lists are close to disjoint. For example, 7.0 % 7.0\% of Florida registrants have a surname belonging to more than one list at a floor of 0.20 0.20 , whereas this proportion is only 0.04 % 0.04\% at a floor of 0.30 0.30 . Raising the floor further reduces coverage among Black registrants while leaving the other three lists almost unchanged (see Table A3 in Appendix A8.2 ). We then rank each surname by how many group members have that surname, beyond the number expected in a random set of the same sample size, i.e., ℙ ⁡ ( S = s ∣ R = r ) − ℙ ⁡ ( S = s ) \Pr(S=s\mid R=r)-\Pr(S=s) . Lastly, we take the 1,000 highest-ranked surnames for each group. Because we construct each list independently across groups, a surname may qualify for more than one list. However, this is rare, as only seven surnames appear on two lists after filtering to the top 1,000.
blocks.zh: 如第4.2节所说明的,有用的清单中的姓名十分普遍,但又很独特,有明确的团体成员。 对于每个r r 组,我们通过过滤到可能属于该组的至少为30%-30-%的姓氏来构建相应的人口普查列表,即P → (R = r → S = s) → 0.30\ (R = r\mid S = s)\ 0.30 2 我们设定下限为 0.30 0.30,因为它是四个列表接近脱节的最小值. 例如,7.0%的佛罗里达登记人拥有一个以上列表的姓,其下限为0.20.20%,而这一比例仅为0.04%.0.04%,下限为0.30.30.30%。 提高下限进一步降低了黑人登记者的覆盖率,而其他三个名单几乎保持不变(见附录A8.2表A3)。 然后我们按每个姓氏的组别成员有多少名进行排序,超越了相同样本大小的随机组合中预期的数,即:P → (S= s → R= r)- P → (S= s) → Pr (S= s=mid R=r)- (S= s= s)- Pr (s). 最后,我们采用每组1000个排名最高的姓氏。 因为我们将每个列表独立地构建到不同组别之间,一个姓氏可能符合一个以上列表的资格. 然而,这很少见,因为过滤到前1000后,只有7个姓氏出现在两个名单上.

blocks.en: We obtain the second set of name lists from an LLM, Gemini 3.0 Flash, as described in Section 4.2 . For ℓ \ell BIFSG, we construct first-name lists in the same two ways, from the 2020 Census first-name table by the rule above and from the LLM with the same prompts. The LLM lists represent a more realistic generation approach for settings where ℓ \ell BISG is being used exactly because the surname frequency tables are unavailable.
blocks.zh: 正如第4.2节所描述的那样,我们从LLM(双子座 3.0 Flash)获得第二组名字清单。 对于l\ell BIFSG,我们以同样的两种方式构建出首名列表,从以上规则的2020年人口普查首名表和LLM中以相同的提示符. LLM列表代表了一种更现实的生成方法,用于i\ell BISG正因为姓氏频率表不可用而正被使用的设置.

blocks.en: Finally, we embed every distinct observed surname and first name using the multilingual E5-large model ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and estimate the list score f e , r f_{e,r} for each list separately using a multilayer perceptron. 3 3 3 The model has two hidden layers of 256 256 and 128 128 units, ReLU activations, and dropout of 0.3 0.3 . We use PyTorch with Adam at a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} and weight decay 10 − 5 10^{-5} under binary cross-entropy. Each model is fitted using five folds so that list scores are computed out-of-sample (see Steps 3–6 of Algorithm 1 ). Within each training set (four folds), we choose the number of epochs by cross-validation, leading to one or two epochs.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们使用多语言的E5大模型(Wang等人,2024年)嵌入每个不同的被观察到的姓氏和首名,并使用多层次的能见度来分别估计每张列表的得分 f e, r f_{e,r}。 3 3 3 该型号有2个隐藏层,256 256和128 128个单元,ReLU活化,退出0.3 0.3. 我们用PyTorch和Adam的学习速度 10 - 3 10 - 3 10 - 3 和体重衰减 10 - 5 10 - 5 在二进制交叉交替下。 每个型号都采用5个折叠法安装,以便计算出清单的分数(见算法1步骤3-6)。 在每个训练集(四叠)内,我们通过交叉验证来选择会场次数,导致会场一到两个会场.

blocks.en: We then apply the ℓ \ell BISG method via Algorithm 1 , selecting the number of clusters with Algorithm 2 , which returns K = 7,500 K=7{,}500 for all four surname lists and both LLM first-name lists, and K = 5,000 K=5{,}000 for both Census first-name lists. 4 4 4 We use the candidate grid ranging from 10 10 to 20,000 20{,}000 clusters, with values of 5,000 5{,}000 , 7,500 7{,}500 , 10,000 10{,}000 , 15,000 15{,}000 , and 20,000 20{,}000 above 3,000 3{,}000 . We fit standard BISG using the same 2020 Census surname table and geographic priors.
blocks.zh: 然后通过Algorithm 1 应用 l\ell BISG 方法,选择带有 Algorithm 2 的群数,该数返回 K = 7,500 K = 7{,} 对于所有四个姓氏列表和 LLM 的首名列表, K = 5000 K = 5{,} 用于两个人口普查的首名列表. 4,4,我们使用候选网格从10个10到20,000个20{,}000个星团,值为5,000个5{,}000个;7,500个7{,}500个;10个10{,}000个;15,000个15{,}000个;以及3,000个3{,}以上的20,000个20{,}000个。 我们使用相同的2020年人口普查姓氏表和地理前科,符合标准的BISG.

blocks.en: Table 1 : Comparison of LLM-based and Census-based surname lists on the Florida registrants. The column labeled as “In Census” shows the share of list names that appear in the 2020 Census surname table at all. “Coverage” is the share of the group’s registrants with a surname on the list, and “Precision” the share of the registrants with a list surname who belong to the group, each computed from the self-reported race (ground truth) and estimated from the tract system with the tract-level race shares as the geographic prior and no individual labels (Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 表1:佛罗里达登记人基于LLM和基于人口普查的姓氏名单比较。 被贴上“在人口普查中”标签的一栏显示2020年人口普查姓氏表所列名单名称的比例。 " 封面 " 是指在名单上有姓的集团登记人的份额,以及属于集团的有名的集团登记人的份额 " 精确 " ,每个登记人来自自报的种族(根据真实情况),并且从有道级种族份额的道系中估算为地理上的先有而无个人标签(第4.3节)。

blocks.en: Before we examine the performance of ℓ \ell BISG, we investigate the quality of LLM name lists relative to that of the Census-based lists, which can be thought of as a gold standard. For these list-quality diagnostics, we aggregate list membership and Census race shares at the tract level. As shown in the column labeled “In Census” in Table 1 , between 97 97 and 100 % 100\% of the LLM surnames generated for each group appear in the Census table, indicating that the model reliably produces plausible names. We note that the Census released the 2020 surname table in April 2026 and that Gemini 3.0 Flash was trained only on data through January 2025, so the validation data is not included in the training data. The 2000 and 2010 surname tables have been public for much longer, and so the model may be aware of them.
blocks.zh: 在我们审查l\ell BISG的性能之前,我们调查LLM名称列表的质量与基于人口普查的列表相比,这可以被认为是金本位. 对于这些列表质量的诊断,我们汇总列出会员和人口普查在道一级的种族份额. 如表1中“普查中”一栏所示,普查表中列出了为每个群体产生的97 97%至100%的LLM姓氏,表明该模型能够可靠地产生可信的姓名。 我们注意到,人口普查于2026年4月发布了2020年姓氏表,双子座 3.0 Flash只接受了至2025年1月的数据培训,因此验证数据没有被包括在培训数据中. 2000年和2010年的姓氏表公开的时间更长了,因此模型可能知道.

blocks.en: The two name list constructions diverge in coverage and precision, in particular for the Black and Asian lists. For Black registrants, the LLM covers 0.53 0.53 of the group against 0.33 0.33 for the Census list. It has a precision of 0.25 0.25 against 0.46 0.46 , indicating that the model returns more common but less distinctive surnames when compared to the Census lists. The LLM is worse on both metrics for Asian registrants, 0.39 0.39 against 0.42 0.42 with respect to coverage and 0.17 0.17 against 0.64 0.64 for precision. For White and Hispanic registrants, the two lists are close on both measures.
blocks.zh: 两个名称列表的构建在覆盖范围和精确度上存在差异,对黑名单和亚洲名单尤其如此。 就黑人登记人而言,LLM涵盖该组人的0.53 0.53人,而人口普查名单为0.33 0.33人。 它的精度为0.250.25,对0.460.46,表明该模型与人口普查清单相比,返回的姓氏更为常见,但差别较小。 对亚洲登记者来说,这两种衡量标准都更差,覆盖率为0.39 0.39比0.42 0.42,精确度为0.17 0.17比0.64 0.64。 对于白人和西班牙裔登记人来说,两份名单都接近于这两项措施。

blocks.en: In addition, the LLM lists overlap across racial groups much more often than the lists based on the Census surname data: 26.9 % 26.9\% of Florida registrants have a surname belonging to more than one LLM list, compared to only 0.04 % 0.04\% for the Census-based lists. This makes sense because our Census-based name list is intentionally constructed to increase distinctiveness.
blocks.zh: 此外,与根据人口普查姓氏数据编制的名单相比,各种族群体之间的LLM名单重叠程度要高得多:26.9%的佛罗里达登记者拥有一个以上LLM名单的姓氏,而根据人口普查编制的名单只有0.04%.04。 这样做是有道理的,因为我们以人口普查为基础的名称清单是有意用来增加其独特性。
