Estimated from the tract-level list hit rates and the published tract race shares alone, D ⁡ ( 𝚷 ) D(\bm{\Pi}) is 0.36 0.36 for the Census lists and 0.34 0.34 for the LLM lists. This suggests that the former is of slightly higher quality than the latter. These estimates are substantively similar to their ground truths based on self-reported race, which are 0.34 0.34 and 0.30 0.30 for the Census and LLM lists, respectively, indicating that the proposed quality measure is reliable.
blocks.zh: 我们还报告第4.3节中提议的清单质量衡量标准,该衡量标准基于矩阵的对角支配地位D-(Π)D(\)D(\(\)D(\( r)(r,r(r)r^{\(^{\))条目-( r)r,r\(pi)\(pi)r(r)}}(r)}}(r)}}(r)}}(r)}}(r)}}(^{\)}}(^{\)}}(^{\)}}(^{\)}}(^{\)}}(^{\)}})}}(see)}}( Figure)}}( Figure)}})}}(Π)}}(^{\)}}) r(^{\)}}(^{\)}}(^{\)}}(^{\)}})}}(^{\) r(^{\)}}) r(^{\)}}(^{\)}})}}(}})}}(}})}})}}(}}) of(}})}}) of(}})}}(}})}}) of(}})}})}}(}}) of(}}) of) of(}}) of) of(}}) of(}}) of) of(}}) of) of(}}) of( 仅根据道级列表的命中率和已公布的道类赛事份额估计,D ⁡ (Π) D (\bm{\Pi})人口普查列表为0.36 0.36分,LLM列表为0.34 0.34分. 这表明前者的质量略高于后者. 这些估计与他们基于自报种族的地表真象实质上相似,普查和LLM名单的地表真象分别为0.34 0.34和0.30 030,表明拟议的质量计量是可靠的.

blocks.en: The estimated 𝚷 \bm{\Pi} matrix also recovers coverage and precision well. Table 1 reports both quantities, as estimated from the tract hit rates and race shares without individual race labels, next to their ground truths. Estimated coverage is within 0.06 0.06 of its ground truth and estimated precision within 0.16 0.16 for every list. The largest differences are observed for the Hispanic lists and the Census Asian list, where the estimates overstate precision. The Census lists are more precise than the LLM lists for every group, both in the ground truth and the estimates.
blocks.zh: 估计的 \ bm Pi}矩阵还恢复了覆盖范围和精度。 表1报告了按地区打击率估计的数量和没有个别种族标签的种族份额,并报告了其基本真相。 估计覆盖范围在地面真相0.06分以内,估计准确度在0.16分以内。 在西班牙人名单和亚洲人口普查名单中观察到的差别最大,估计数字夸大了精确度。 人口普查名单比每个群体的LLM名单更为精确,无论是在基本事实还是估计数字上都是如此。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Precision and recall for ℓ \ell BISG (LLM lists, red, solid), standard BISG (blue, dashed) and geography alone (grey, dotted), by state (rows) and race (columns). Average precision is reported above each panel.
blocks.zh: 图2:l\ell BISG(LLM列表,红色,固态),标准BISG(蓝色,破折)和仅地理学(灰色,被点)的精度和回想,按状态(行)和种族(列). 每个面板上均报告平均精度。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Calibration of estimated individual race probabilities based on ℓ \ell BISG (LLM lists, red, solid) and standard BISG (blue, dashed) for Florida (top row) and North Carolina (bottom row). The dashed diagonal marks perfect agreement between estimated probabilities and observed proportions. The area of each circle is proportional to the number of registrants in the bin.
blocks.zh: 图3:根据l\ell BISG(LLM列表,红色,固体)和标准BISG(蓝色,破碎)对佛罗里达州(上行)和北卡罗来纳州(下行)进行估计个人种族概率校正. 破碎的对角标志在估计概率和观察到的比例之间完全一致。 每个圆圈的面积与本站的注册人数成正比.

blocks.en: We compare the empirical performance of ℓ \ell BISG with LLM lists and standard BISG for Florida and North Carolina. As shown in Figure 2 , ℓ \ell BISG (red solid line) nearly matches the precision and recall of standard BISG (blue dashed line) for Whites in both states and Hispanics in Florida, despite having no access to a surname frequency table. For Black and Asian voters, standard BISG outperforms ℓ \ell BISG, by more for Asian voters; standard BISG also performs better for Hispanics in North Carolina. This reflects the lower precision of the LLM name lists for these two groups (Table 1 ). In all cases, ℓ \ell BISG is still a substantial improvement on using geography-based probabilities alone (gray dotted line).
blocks.zh: 我们比较了I\ell BISG的经验性能与LLM列表和佛罗里达州和北卡罗来纳州的标准BISG. 如图2所示,l\ell BISG(红色固态线)几乎与两个州和佛罗里达的西班牙裔白人的标准BISG(蓝色破折线)的精度和召回相匹配,尽管无法访问姓氏频率表. 对黑人和亚洲选民而言,标准BISG的成绩优于I\ellBISG,对亚洲选民而言更多;标准BISG对北卡罗莱纳州的西班牙裔选民也表现更好. 这反映出这两个组的LLM名称清单的精度较低(表1)。 在所有情况下,I\ell BISG在仅使用基于地理学的概率(gray dotted line)方面仍然是一个很大的改进.

blocks.en: Figure 3 evaluates calibration, showing how closely the predicted individual race probabilities correspond to observed group frequencies. With the exception of the Hispanic group in Florida, the calibration patterns are similar for ℓ \ell BISG and standard BISG. Calibration is notably imperfect in the Asian and Hispanic groups, but this is true for either method. For Black voters, both methods have expected calibration error of about 0.02 0.02 or less in Florida and about 0.03 0.03 in North Carolina. For White voters, ℓ \ell BISG probabilities tend to slightly underpredict this racial group.
blocks.zh: 图3评价了校正,显示了预测的个体种族概率与所观测到的群体频率的对应程度. 除佛罗里达的西班牙人组外,校正图案对于l\ell BISG和标准BISG类似. 校正在亚洲和西班牙语组明显不完美,但这两种方法都是如此。 对于黑人选民来说,这两种方法都预计佛罗里达州的校正误差约为0.020.02分或更小,而北卡罗莱纳州的校正误差约为0.03分. 对于白人选民来说,I\ell BISG概率往往略微低估了这个种族群体.

blocks.en: We also evaluate the validity of downstream analysis using the individual race probabilities obtained from ℓ \ell BISG. We estimate the Democratic share of registrants in each racial group with BIRDiE (see McCartan et al., 2025 , for details) . BIRDiE takes the ℓ \ell BISG probabilities as its first-stage estimates and then uses the surname as a proxy predictive of race, while assuming that the surname is independent of the outcome conditional on race and geography. Although the BIRDiE assumption may not hold perfectly, it corrects the attenuation bias of other standard downstream estimation approaches that assume conditional independence between race and outcome conditional on name and geography. 5 5 5 This latter assumption, which is made in some standard estimation approaches, is especially difficult to justify for Black and white Americans who have similar surnames. We fit BIRDiE jointly over all five racial categories at the county level, with partial pooling across counties because the race-by-county cells for the smaller groups hold few registrants. For each racial group, we compute the bias and RMSE over every county, weighting each county via the number of the group’s members implied by the geographic prior.
blocks.zh: 我们还利用从l\ell BISG获得的个别种族概率来评价下游分析的有效性. 我们估计每个种族群体中民主党登记人与BIRDIE的比例(详见McCartan等,2025年)。 BIRDIE将l\ell BISG概率作为其第一阶段估计,然后使用取名作为种族的代预测,同时假设取名独立于以种族和地理学为条件的结果. 虽然BIRDIE假设可能并不完美,但它纠正了其他标准下游估计方法的减弱偏差,这些方法假定种族和结果之间有条件的独立,并以名称和地理为条件. 5 5 后一种假设是在某些标准估计方法中作出的,对于有相近姓氏的美国黑人和白人来说,特别难以说明理由. 我们为县一级所有5个种族类别共同配齐了BIRDIE, 部分地汇集到各县, 对每个种族群体来说,我们计算出对每个县的偏见和RMSE,通过地理上前所隐含的每个县的成员人数来加权。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : County-level race-specific estimates of the Democratic share of registrants. Rows give signed bias (top) and root-mean-square error (bottom), both in percentage points and averaged over counties. The left two columns are Florida and the right two North Carolina, each pair showing the surname-only estimators (BISG) and then those that add first names (BIFSG). Red bars are the ℓ \ell BISG/ ℓ \ell BIFSG (LLM lists) estimators, while blue bars are the estimates based on the standard BISG/BIFSG.
blocks.zh: 图4:县级登记人中民主党所占份额按种族分列的估计数。 行给出了签名的偏差(上)和root-mean-quare出错(下),既以百分点表示,又以县为平均值. 左两栏是佛罗里达和右两栏北卡罗来纳,每对显示只有姓氏的刻度(BISG),再增加先名(BIFSG). 红条是l\ell BISG/l\ell BIFSG(LLM列表)的估算符,而蓝条则是基于标准BISG/BIFSG的估算.

blocks.en: Figure 4 compares the estimated Democratic share of each racial group at the county level against the truth. The top panel shows that the magnitude of bias is smaller for ℓ \ell BISG (red bars) than for standard BISG (blue bars) for both White and Black registrants in both states. For Hispanic and Asian registrants, the bias of ℓ \ell BISG is smaller in Florida, but in North Carolina, where biases are overall larger, there is an increase in bias relative to the standard BISG, again reflecting the low list quality identified above.
blocks.zh: 图4对照事实比较了县一级每个种族群体中估计的民主党所占的份额。 顶部面板显示,I\ell BISG(红条)的偏差比两个州的白人和黑人登记人的标准BISG(蓝条)要小. 对于西班牙和亚洲的注册人来说,I\ell BISG在佛罗里达州的偏差较小,但在偏差总体较大的北卡罗莱纳州,相对于标准BISG的偏差也有所增加,这再次反映了上面确定的低列表质量.

blocks.en: The bottom panel shows the root mean squared error (RMSE) has an inconsistent pattern for ℓ \ell BISG versus standard BISG. Specifically, ℓ \ell BISG improves on standard BISG for White and Hispanic registrants in Florida. ℓ \ell BISG is within 0.1 0.1 percentage points (ppts) of standard BISG in county RMSE for White registrants in both states. For Black registrants, ℓ \ell BISG falls behind standard BISG by 0.4 0.4 ppts in Florida and improves on it by 1.1 1.1 ppts in North Carolina. For Hispanic registrants in North Carolina, ℓ \ell BISG falls behind standard BISG by 1.2 1.2 ppts. ℓ \ell BISG also falls behind standard BISG for the rarer Asian group, whose name list is weaker, by 0.7 0.7 ppts in Florida and 1.7 1.7 ppts in North Carolina.
blocks.zh: 下方面板显示根平均平方差错(RMSE)对l\ell BISG与标准BISG有不一致的模式. 具体地说,我/ell BISG改进了佛州白人和西班牙裔登记人的标准BISG. l\ell BISG在两个州的白人登记人RMSE县标准BISG的0.1个百分点(ppts)以内. 对于黑人登记者,l\ellBISG在佛罗里达州比标准BISG低0.4 ppt,在北卡罗来纳州比高1.1 ppt. 对于北卡罗来纳州的西班牙裔注册人,我/ell BISG比标准BISG低1.2 1.2 ppt. l\ell BISG也落后于标准BISG 对于更稀有的亚洲组,其名称列表较弱,佛罗里达州为0.7ppt,北卡罗来纳州为1.7 1.7ppt.

blocks.en: Adding first names ( ℓ \ell BIFSG) lowers county-level error in most cases. In terms of RMSE, ℓ \ell BIFSG improves on ℓ \ell BISG for all four groups in North Carolina, by 1.1 1.1 ppts for Black registrants and 1.2 1.2 ppts for Asian registrants, with White RMSE essentially unchanged. Similarly, ℓ \ell BIFSG improves upon ℓ \ell BISG for three of the four groups in Florida, by between 0.3 0.3 and 1.1 1.1 ppts. For Black registrants in North Carolina, ℓ \ell BIFSG outperforms standard BIFSG by 3.9 3.9 ppts. For bias, the addition of first names moves two of the four groups in each state farther from zero, and Black absolute bias decreases in both states, from 2.3 2.3 to 0.7 0.7 ppts in Florida and from 2.4 2.4 to 1.3 1.3 ppts in North Carolina. Standard BIFSG likewise improves upon standard BISG in RMSE for five of the eight state-group pairs, the exceptions being Black registrants in both states and White registrants in North Carolina.
blocks.zh: 添加首名( l\ell BIFSG) 在多数情况下会降低县级错误. 在RMSE方面,I\ell BIFSG改进了北卡罗来纳州所有4个组的I\ell BISG,黑人登记者为1.1 ppt,亚洲登记者为1.2 ppt,而White RMSE基本不变. 同样,在佛罗里达的4个小组中,3个小组的BISG比BISG有所改善,在0.3至1.1分之间。 对于北卡罗来纳州的黑人注册人,我\ell BIFSG比标准BIFSG的成绩高出了3.9 3.9ppt. 对于偏差,添加名将每个州的4个组中的2个从零移动得更远,而黑绝对偏差在两个州都有所减少,从佛罗里达州的2.3 2.3到0.7 ppt,从北卡罗来纳州的2.4 2.4到1.3 1.3 ppt. 标准BIFSG同样改进了RMSE中8个州组对中的5个州组对的标准BISG,但各州的黑人登记者和北卡罗来纳州的白人登记者除外.

blocks.en: We also repeat the downstream analysis using the Census lists (see Figure A10 in the Appendix). The results are similar to those based on the LLM lists shown here, with a few moderate differences. For both absolute bias and RMSE, the Census lists yield slightly lower or essentially identical results for all groups in Florida and North Carolina – with the exception of Asian registrants in Florida, who have notably lower bias but higher RMSE when using the census lists.
blocks.zh: 我们还利用人口普查清单重复下游分析(见附录图A10)。 其结果与此处所显示的LLM列表类似,略有不同. 就绝对偏向和RMSE而言,人口普查名单对佛罗里达州和北卡罗来纳州所有群体的结果略低或基本相同,但佛罗里达州的亚洲登记者除外,他们在使用人口普查名单时有明显较低的偏向,但RMSE更高.

blocks.en: Overall, we find that ℓ \ell BISG is comparable to standard BISG in accuracy, calibration, and downstream analysis validity, while first names improve performance further through ℓ \ell BIFSG. Group-specific performance results depend on measurable group-specific list quality. With respect to the LLM lists, the Asian list is weak in precision, and for this group, the downstream analysis based on ℓ \ell BISG is less accurate than that based on standard BISG.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们发现l\ellBISG在准确性,校正性和下游分析有效性方面与BISG标准相当,而首名则通过l\ellBIFSG进一步提高了性能. 具体团体的业绩成果取决于可衡量具体团体名单的质量。 关于LLM列表,亚洲列表的精确度很弱,对于这一组,基于l\ell BISG的下游分析不如基于标准BISG的分析准确.

blocks.en: 5.2 Predicting Asian subgroups using US historical census
blocks.zh: 5.2 预测利用美国历史人口普查的亚洲分组

blocks.en: We next turn to the US historical census, which provides population-scale, individual-level records decennially from 1850 to 1950 ( Nelson et al., 2025 ) . We focus on the 1900 census, which includes, among other information, individual name, race, and country of origin, and enumerates Chinese and Japanese as separate ethnic groups. We validate ℓ \ell BISG estimates against these two groups as enumerated in the race field of each individual record, regardless of birthplace.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来谈谈美国历史普查,该普查从1850年到1950年,每十年提供一次人口规模的个人记录(Nelson等人,2025年)。 我们注重1900年的人口普查,其中除了其他资料外,还包括个人姓名,种族,和原籍国,并将中日两国列为单独的民族. 我们验证了BISG对这两个群体的估计,这些估计列在每个个人记录的种族领域,而不论出生地。

blocks.en: We consider the challenging setting of Section 3.3 , in which the geographic prevalence of the target groups (i.e., Chinese and Japanese) is unknown while that of their coarser group (i.e., Asian) is available. This is the setting where name lists are required because we recover the subgroup geographic prevalence from the rates at which the people in a given county have surnames on each list. We do not assume that it is known who is in the Asian group, so we also include a group for each of the other races. This validation set-up mimics a relevant contemporary ℓ \ell BISG application: Standard BISG is not applicable for more recent Censuses because neither surname frequency tables nor geographic prevalence information exists (or has been made public) for Asian sub-groups.
blocks.zh: 我们认为第3.3节具有挑战性,其中目标群体(即中国人和日本人)的地理流行率不明,而其较近群体(即亚洲人)的地理流行率尚可。 这就是需要名单的设定,因为我们从特定县人在每个名单上姓的比例中恢复了分组的地域普及率。 我们并不认为谁是亚洲国家集团的成员,因此我们还包括一个其他各种族的集团。 此验证设置模仿了相关的当代 l\ ell BISG 应用程序 : 标准BISG不适用于更近期的人口普查,因为亚洲亚组既没有姓氏频率表,也没有地理流行信息(或已经公开)。

blocks.en: We use the de-anonymized (restricted access) 1900 Federal Census. By 1900, approximately 126,000 126{,}000 Chinese and 94,000 94{,}000 Japanese Americans were enumerated living in the US, concentrated in the West and in Hawaii. No other Asian group numbered more than 1,000 1{,}000 . We therefore use the Chinese and Japanese populations as the two target subgroups, and the Asian population as the coarse group. The published tables of the 1900 census report the size of the Asian population in every county but do not decompose this by country of origin. Therefore, if we were using only public information, we would know the geographic prevalence of the coarse group but not of the subgroups, which corresponds exactly to the setting described in Section 3.3 . We apply ℓ \ell BISG to all 75,790,807 75{,}790{,}807 records of the census, of every race. The groups are Chinese and Japanese, within the Asian coarse group, the other coarse racial groups are white, Black, Native American (“American Indian”), and a residual group. Like today’s Census, the 1900 Census published tables reporting the size of each coarse group in every county.
blocks.zh: 我们使用1900年联邦人口普查的非匿名(限制进入). 到1900年,大约126,000个126{,}000个中国人和94,000个中国人 居住在美国,集中在西部和夏威夷的美国日裔美国人。 其他亚洲组数不超过1,000 1{,}000。 因此,我们把中国和日本人口作为两个目标分组,把亚洲人口作为粗人分组。 1900年人口普查公布的表格报告每个县的亚裔人口规模,但没有按原籍国进行分解. 因此,如果我们仅仅使用公共信息,我们就会知道粗人组的地理分布,而不是分组的地理分布,这完全符合第3.3节所述的情况。 我们对所有75,790,807 75{,}790{,}807的人口普查记录,每个种族都适用I\ell BISG。 这些群体是中国人和日本人,在亚洲粗人群体中,其他粗人种族群体是白人、黑人、美洲原住民(“美国印第安人”)和一残余群体。 与今天的人口普查一样,1900年的人口普查公布了表格,报告每个县每个粗人组的规模.

blocks.en: We conduct two analyses. First, we consider “oracle ℓ \ell BISG” as a benchmark. Specifically, we treat the county geography of the two subgroups as known by constructing the geographic prior from the census records themselves and apply the ℓ \ell BISG method. Second, we conduct a more realistic “coarse prior ℓ \ell BISG” analysis from Section 3 , where we treat only the geographic prevalence of the coarse groups as known (the Asian, white, Black, American Indian, and other residents of each county). Here, we recover the subgroup shares in each county from the list hit rates by applying the method described in Section 3.3 under Assumption 3.2 . Then, we apply the main ℓ \ell BISG method to an LLM-based name list for each group. Finally, for both analyses, we conduct a downstream analysis to estimate each subgroup’s socioeconomic standing at the same county level.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了两次分析。 首先,我们认为“生命之道”是一个基准。 具体地说,我们处理两个分组的县地理学,在人口普查记录本身之前先构建地理,并采用l-ell BISG方法。 第二,我们从第3节进行更现实的“粗糙的先行”分析,其中我们只处理已知粗糙群体(亚洲人、白人、黑人、美国印第安人和每个县的其他居民)的地理分布。 在此,我们采用假设3.2第3.3节所描述的方法,从列表打击率中取回各县的分公司股份。 然后,我们将主要 l\ell BISG 方法应用于每个组的 LLM 名称列表 。 最后,对于这两种分析,我们进行下游分析,估计每个分组在同一县级的社会经济地位。

blocks.en: The additional assumption (Assumption 3.2 ) for coarse prior ℓ \ell BISG is that a person has a surname on a subgroup’s list only if they belong to that subgroup (see also Assumption A6.1 ). Chinese and Japanese surnames largely do not overlap with each other (only five surnames appear on both lists), but many white Americans carry a surname on the Chinese list, so this assumption does not hold exactly here. The validation against oracle ℓ \ell BISG gives us the opportunity to see how much this matters.
blocks.zh: 对粗糙的前 l\ell BISG 的附加假设(Assumption 3.2 )是,一个人只有在属于该分组的情况下才在分组名单上有一个姓(另见Assumption A6.1 )。 中国和日本的姓氏基本不相重叠(两个名表上只出现五个名表),但许多美国白人在中文名表上都带有一个名表,因此这个假设并不完全在这里. 对oracle l\ell BISG的验证让我们有机会看到这有多重要.

blocks.en: For both versions of ℓ \ell BISG, we construct a name list for each subgroup by prompting an LLM. As in Section 5.1 , we also use an LLM, Gemini 3.0 Flash, to assist in writing these prompts. For each subgroup, we ask the model to propose three short descriptions that identify subgroups within that population, then substitute these descriptions into the same skeleton, which asks for surnames “spelled as they were written in American census and immigration records of that period.” For example, for the Chinese population, the descriptions are “Cantonese families from the Pearl River Delta settling in California and the American West,” “Taishanese and Sze Yup laborers migrating to the sugar plantations of the Hawaiian Islands,” and “Fujianese and Hokkien merchants and sailors establishing communities in Atlantic port cities like New York.” We form lists for each of the white, Black, and American Indian groups in the same way, with each prompt referring to its population “in the United States around 1900”; the residual group of other residents has no list. Appendix A7 lists the descriptions generated for every group.
blocks.zh: 对于两个版本的 l\ell BISG, 我们通过提示 LLM 来构建每个分组的名称列表 。 如同第5.1节一样,我们也使用LLM,双子座 3.0 Flash来协助撰写这些提示. 对于每个分组,我们请模型提出三个简短的描述,确定该人群中的分组,然后将这些描述取而代之,取而代之的是同一个骨架,要求使用“在那个时期的美国人口普查和移民记录中写明的”姓氏。 例如,对于中国人来说,描述是“来自位于加利福尼亚和美国西部的珠江三角洲的Cantonese家庭 ” , “ Taishanese和Sze Yup劳工移民到夏威夷群岛的糖种植园 ” , “ Fujianese和Hokkien商人和水手在纽约等大西洋港口城市建立社区 ” 。 我们以同样的方式为每一个白人、黑人和美国印第安人群体编制名单,每份名单都提到其人口“大约在1900年美国”;其他居民的剩余群体没有名单。 附录A7列出了为每个组生成的描述.

blocks.en: For each prompt, we make six separate model calls at temperature 1.0 1.0 , requesting 300 300 surnames per call, rank the unique surnames by the number of calls that returned them, and retain the top 1,000 1{,}000 , breaking ties by the order in which the model first returned each surname. To make Assumption 3.2 as credible as possible, we then apply the exclusivity filter between the Chinese and Japanese lists, dropping the five surnames that appear on both, and between either of them and the white, Black, and American Indian lists. These three lists are allowed to share surnames with one another because the geographic prevalence of their groups is known and does not need to be recovered.
blocks.zh: 每一次,我们都会在1.0 1.0 温度下分别打出6个型号呼叫,要求每次呼叫300个姓,按返回的来电数对独有的姓进行排序,并保留前1000 1{}000,按该型号首次回回每个姓的顺序断开联系. 为了让Assumtion 3.2尽可能可信,我们接着在中日两国名单之间实行排他性过滤,将两种名单上出现的五个姓氏,以及其中任何一个与白人,黑人和美国印第安人名单之间都放弃. 这三个名单可以互相分享姓氏,因为其群体的地域普遍程度是众所周知的,不需要恢复.

blocks.en: After filtering, the Chinese list holds 966 966 surnames, the Japanese list 994 994 , and the white, Black, and American Indian lists 986 986 , 986 986 , and 978 978 . Even so, when comparing with the individual-level ground truth, we find that 81 % 81\% of the people with a surname on the Chinese list and 29 % 29\% of those with a surname on the Japanese list are not Asian. Examples of Japanese surnames that overlap with white Americans includes Ohara, with Irish immigrants, and Ide, with English and German immigrants. Various Cantonese romanizations such as Fay, Law, and Hay coincide with common English, Scottish, and German surnames.
blocks.zh: 过滤后,"中国名表"有966个966个姓氏,"日本名表"有994个994个姓氏;"白人","黑人","美国印第安人"有986个986个,"986个986个","978个". 即使如此,与个人层面的基本事实相比,我们发现81%的中国名单上有姓的人和29%的日本名单上有姓的人不是亚洲人。 与美国白人相重叠的日本姓氏的例子有:与爱尔兰移民相伴的奥哈拉和与英德移民相伴的爱德. 各种广东化的罗马化如费伊,劳和海与常见的英语,苏格兰语和德语姓氏相接.

blocks.en: Because the white population is more than 300 300 times larger than the Asian population at this time, however, only 0.4 % 0.4\% of the people who are not Asian have a surname on the Chinese list, and 0.01 % 0.01\% a surname on the Japanese list. Within the Asian population, 0.9 % 0.9\% of Japanese records have a surname on the Chinese list, and 0.05 % 0.05\% of Chinese records a surname on the Japanese list. Crucially, these numbers mean that the relevant cross probabilities ℙ ⁡ ( L r = 1 ∣ R = r ′ ) \Pr(L_{r}=1\mid R=r^{\prime}) , which we treat as 0 0 for the method in Section 3.3 , are in fact small. The low precision ℙ ⁡ ( R = r ∣ L r = 1 ) \Pr(R=r\mid L_{r}=1) plays no direct role in our method.
blocks.zh: 由于白人人口是目前亚洲人口的300多倍,然而,中国名单上只有0.4%的不是亚洲人的人有姓,而日本名单上只有0.01%的人有姓. 在亚洲人口中,有0.9%的日本唱片在中文榜上有姓;有0.05%的中国唱片在日本榜上有姓. 关键是,这些数字意味着相关的交叉概率P ⁡ (L r = 1 ∣ R = r ′)\Pr (L _{ r}= 1\mid R = r^{\prime }),我们把第3.3节中的方法当作0 0,事实上是很小的. 低精度P  (R=r ∣ L = 1)\Pr (R=r\mid L_{r}= 1)在我们的方法中没有直接的作用.

blocks.en: The remaining steps follow Algorithm 1 . We embed surnames using the multilingual E5-large model and estimate 𝒇 ^ \hat{\bm{f}} in the same way as done in Section 5.1 . We apply Algorithm 2 to a random sample of 5,000,000 5{,}000{,}000 records, which returns K = 67,500 K=67{,}500 under both priors, and then apply Algorithm 1 to all records.
blocks.zh: 其余步骤遵循了"算法一". 我们使用多种语言的E5大模型嵌入了姓氏,并用与第5.1节相同的方式估计 f^\hat\bm{f}。 我们把算法2应用于随机抽样的5,000,000 5{,}0000{,}0000个记录,在两个前作下返回K=67,500 K=67{,}500个,然后对所有记录应用算法1.

blocks.en: Table 2 : Quality of the five LLM lists on the full-count 1900 census. “Records” counts the true number of people enumerated in each group. “Coverage” is the share of those records with a surname on the group’s list, and “Precision” the share of all people with a surname on the list who belong to the group. “Truth” is computed from the enumerated race and ethnicity. “Oracle” is estimated by the method of Section 4.3 with the true county prevalence of every group. “Coarse” uses only the coarse geography: for the Chinese and Japanese lists, coverage is obtained from the county-level list hit rates and the county Asian share by the method of Section 3 , and precision is the estimated coverage times the recovered number of subgroup members, as a share of the people holding a list surname; for the other lists, whose county prevalence is known, it equals the method of Section 4.3 .
blocks.zh: 表2:1900年人口普查全数中五个LLM列表的质量. “记录”数是每一组所列人员的真实人数。 " 封面 " 是指在集团名单上有姓的记录的份额,以及属于集团名单上有姓的所有人的份额。 “真理”是根据所列举的种族和族裔计算的。 “甲骨文”按照第4.3节的方法估计,每个群体在县内都确实普遍。 “粗体”只使用粗体地理学:对于中国和日本的列表,从县级列表点击率和县亚裔份额中获取覆盖率,精确度是收回的分组成员数的估计覆盖时间,作为拥有列表姓氏者的比例;对于其他列表,其县级流行率已知,相当于第4.3节的方法。

blocks.en: Table 2 reports the true coverage and precision for each list computed from the enumerated ethnicity. The Chinese list covers 0.55 0.55 of Chinese records with a precision of 0.19 0.19 , and the Japanese list covers 0.26 0.26 of Japanese records with a precision of 0.71 0.71 . The precision of the Chinese list is low because most people holding a surname on it are the white Americans described above. The American Indian list has almost no precision because nearly every person holding one of its surnames is white or Black. With the true geographic prevalence of every group, the method of Section 4.3 estimates the coverage of every list within 0.15 0.15 of its ground truth and the precision within 0.05 0.05 .
blocks.zh: 表2按所列族裔列出了每份名单的真正覆盖范围和准确性。 中文列表收录了中国唱片的0.55 0.55分,精度为0.19 0.19分;日本列表收录了日本唱片的0.26 0.26分,精度为0.71 0.71分. 中国列表的精度较低,因为上面有姓氏的多数人都是上述美国白人. 美国印第安人列表几乎没有准确性,因为几乎每个拥有其姓氏之一的人都是白人或黑人. 第4.3节的方法估计,每份清单的覆盖范围在0.15至0.15以内,准确度在0.05至0.05以内。

blocks.en: For the coarse prior ℓ \ell BISG, we cannot estimate the full 𝚷 \bm{\Pi} when sub-group geography is unknown, but the subgroup recovery method of Section 3 does, under the assumption that 𝚷 \bm{\Pi} is diagonal, produce an estimate of the coverage of each list based on the county-level list hit rates and the coarse geography alone. Here, we find that this coverage estimate is within 0.04 0.04 of its ground truth for both lists, and the recovered county subgroup shares correlate with the truth at 0.96 0.96 , weighting counties by their Asian population. The estimated precision is within 0.04 0.04 of its ground truth for both lists.
blocks.zh: 对于粗糙的前 l\ell BISG, 我们不能估计完整的\\\ bm\ Pi}当子组地理不明时,但第3节的子组恢复方法确实如此,假设是\\bm\\ Pi}是对角的,根据县级列表的点击率和粗糙的地理学来估计每个列表的覆盖范围. 在此,我们发现,这一覆盖面估计在两个名单的0.04 . . . . 0. . 估计精确度在两个清单的 0.04 分内。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Precision and recall (top) and calibration (bottom) over all records of the census for coarse prior ℓ \ell BISG, which recovers the subgroup geography from the coarse geography and the lists by the method of Section 3.3 (red, solid); oracle ℓ \ell BISG, which uses the true subgroup geography (blue, dashed); and, in the top panel, recovered geography, the county subgroup shares (grey, dotted), by subgroup. In the bottom panel, the dashed diagonal marks perfect agreement between estimated probabilities and observed proportions. The area of each circle is proportional to the number of records in the bin.
blocks.zh: 图5: 粗糙的前 l\ell BISG 普查的所有记录的精度和回想(上)和校正(下),它从粗糙的地理学和列表中以 第3.3 节(红色,固态); oracle l\ell BISG 使用真实的分地理学(蓝色,已破损); 在顶板中,恢复地理学,县分地理学(灰色,被点)由分地. 在底板上,破碎的对角分数在估计概率和观察到的比例之间完全一致。 每个圆圈的面积与本站记录的数量成正比.

blocks.en: We compare the empirical performance of coarse prior ℓ \ell BISG against oracle ℓ \ell BISG, as well as against using the recovered geography alone. As shown in Figure 5 , coarse prior ℓ \ell BISG (red solid line) approaches oracle ℓ \ell BISG (blue dashed line): average precision over all records is 0.52 0.52 against 0.52 0.52 for Chinese records and 0.72 0.72 against 0.73 0.73 for Japanese records, whereas recovered geography yields only 0.12 0.12 and 0.37 0.37 , respectively. Among the Asian records alone, average precision is 0.88 0.88 against 0.89 0.89 for Chinese records and 0.88 0.88 against 0.90 0.90 for Japanese records.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了粗糙的前 l\ell BISG 的经验性表现与甲骨文 l\ell BISG 以及仅使用已恢复的地理学. 如图5所示,粗体前 l\ell BISG(红色固态线)接近oracle l\ell BISG(蓝色破损线):所有记录的平均精度为:中国记录为0.52 0.52比0.52;日本记录为0.72 0.72比0.73,而恢复的地理产量分别为0.12 0.12和0.37 0.37. 仅在亚洲唱片中,中国唱片的平均精度为0.88 0.88分,而中国唱片的精度为0.89 0.89分,日本唱片的精度为0.98 0.98分.

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows that, under both ℓ \ell BISG and its oracle version, the two subgroups are over-predicted at high probabilities: among the records assigned a probability near 0.97 0.97 of being Japanese, 0.73 0.73 are Japanese. The expected calibration error over all records is about 0.001 0.001 for both ℓ \ell BISG and its oracle version because nearly every record receives a probability near zero.
blocks.zh: 图5显示,在l\ell BISG及其甲骨文版本下,两个分组的概率过高:在记录中,指定概率为日本人近0.97 0.97,0.73为日本人. 所有记录的预期校正误差为:l\ell BISG及其甲骨文版本约0.001 001.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : County-level subgroup-specific estimates of the share in the top quartile of the 1900 socioeconomic index. Panels give signed bias (left) and root-mean-square error (right), both in percentage points. Red bars are coarse prior ℓ \ell BISG, blue bars oracle ℓ \ell BISG, and grey bars recovered geography only.
blocks.zh: 图6:1900年社会经济指数中最高四分位数的县级分组具体估计数。 面板给出了签名偏差(左)和root-mean-quare 错误(右),均以百分点表示. 红条是粗糙的前 l\ell BISG,蓝条甲骨文 l\ell BISG,灰条只恢复了地理学.

blocks.en: We also evaluate the validity of downstream analysis based on the probabilities obtained using ℓ \ell BISG. We estimate the share of each subgroup in the top quartile of the 1900 socioeconomic index within each county, among the 24,235,916 24{,}235{,}916 records of every race in the labor force with a recorded index value. The index is the Duncan socioeconomic index provided by IPUMS ( Nelson et al., 2025 ) , which scores each occupation by the income and education of its members in 1950. We fit a single jointly estimated BIRDiE model over all six groups with complete pooling ( McCartan et al., 2025 ) , and score every county, weighting each county’s error by the subgroup’s expected count under the recovered geographic prior. We compare ℓ \ell BISG against oracle ℓ \ell BISG and geography alone.
blocks.zh: 我们还根据使用l\ell BISG获得的概率来评价下游分析的有效性. 我们估计每个县1900年社会经济指数最高四分位数中,每个分组在24,235,916 24{,}235{,}916个有记录指数的劳动力中,所占的份额。 该指数是议会联盟监测系统提供的邓肯社会经济指数(Nelson等,2025年),该指数按1950年成员的收入和教育对每个职业进行评分。 我们对所有6个群体采用一个共同估算的BIRDIE模型,并配有完整的集合(McCartan等,2025年),并给每个县打分,将每个县的误差按该分组的预期数按恢复的地理前数加权。 我们把BISG和Oracle比作BISG和地理

blocks.en: Figure 6 compares the estimated top-quartile share of each subgroup at the county level against the truth. The bias of ℓ \ell BISG is close to that of oracle ℓ \ell BISG: 5.4 5.4 against 4.9 4.9 for Chinese records and 0.3 0.3 against 0.2 0.2 for Japanese, whereas using recovered geography alone yields 15.5 15.5 and 10.1 10.1 ppts. The county RMSE of ℓ \ell BISG is 8.8 8.8 against 8.5 8.5 ppts for Chinese records and 5.0 5.0 against 5.0 5.0 for Japanese, against 20.9 20.9 and 13.6 13.6 for recovered geography only. Overall, we find that coarse prior ℓ \ell BISG approaches oracle ℓ \ell BISG in accuracy, calibration, and downstream analysis validity. Thus, this validation exercise demonstrates the applicability of ℓ \ell BISG to subgroups for which neither a surname table nor a geographic prior exists.
blocks.zh: 图6对照事实比较了每个县级分组的估计最高数量份额。 I\ell BISG的偏差接近于oracle l\ell BISG:中国记录5.4比 4.9 4.9,日本记录0.3比0.2 0.2,而仅使用恢复地理学就产生15.5 15.5和10.1 10.1 ppt. l\ell BISG的县级RMSE为:中国纪录8.8 8.8比8.5 ppt;日本纪录5.0比5.0 5.0,仅恢复地理学20.9 20.9和13.6 13.6. 总而言之,我们发现粗糙的前l\ell BISG在准确性,校正性和下游分析有效性方面接近了Oracle l\ell BISG. 因此,这项验证工作表明,l / ell BISG适用于既无姓氏表又无地理前传的分组。

blocks.en: 5.3 Predicting religious sects in Lebanon using voter files
blocks.zh: 5.3 利用选民档案预测黎巴嫩的宗教派别

blocks.en: Finally, we turn to Lebanon and apply ℓ \ell BISG outside the United States to predict individuals’ religious sect memberships rather than their racial and ethnic identities.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们转向黎巴嫩,并使用我在美国境外的BISG来预测个人的宗教派别成员,而不是他们的种族和族裔身份。

blocks.en: We use full-count voter files, containing 3,676,322 3{,}676{,}322 registrants, which were published by the Lebanese Ministry of Interior and Municipalities through the Directorate General of Civil Status on 1 February 2018. We drop the 14,388 14{,}388 voters whose sectarian memberships are missing. After also requiring usable names and geography, the file contains 3,661,930 3{,}661{,}930 registrants. Each file contains the full name, location of residence, and self-reported religious sect of each registrant ( Dasanaike, 2026 ) . We consider the seven largest sects, together comprising 96.6 % 96.6\% of all registrants, and collapse the remaining 125,534 125{,}534 registrants into the residual group. These seven sects are the Shia, at 29.9 % 29.9\% of all registrants, Sunni ( 27.1 % 27.1\% ), Maronite ( 19.8 % 19.8\% ), Roman Orthodox ( 7.0 % 7.0\% ), Druze ( 5.5 % 5.5\% ), Roman Catholic ( 4.9 % 4.9\% ), and Armenian Orthodox ( 2.4 % 2.4\% ). No other sect comprises more than 1 % 1\% of the roll.
blocks.zh: 我们使用完整计票选民档案,包含3,676,322 3{,}676{,}322名登记者,由黎巴嫩内政和市政部于2018年2月1日通过公民身份总局公布. 我们放弃了14 388 14{,}388名选民 他们的宗派成员缺失。 在还要求使用的名称和地理之后,文件包含有3,661,930 3{,}661{,}930名注册人. 每个档案中都有每个登记者的全名、居住地和自报的宗教教派(Dasanaike,2026年)。 我们认为,7个最大的教派包括96.6%的登记者,其余125 534 125{}534名登记者被解散。 这七个教派是什叶派,占所有登记者的29.9%;逊尼派(27.1%;27.1%;马龙派(19.8%;19.8%);罗马正教(7.0%;7.0%;德鲁兹派(5.5%;5.5);罗马天主教(4.9%;4.9%;亚美尼亚正教(2.4%;2.4%)。 其他任何一款都不超过本卷的1%。

blocks.en: Surnames are more informative about religious sects in Lebanon than about racial groups in the United States because families tend to be confessionally endogamous. However, that informativeness is unevenly distributed. The least distinctive names belong to the smaller Christian sects, whose surnames come from a Levantine Arabic ancestry shared with larger neighbors.
blocks.zh: 姓氏在黎巴嫩比在美国的种族群体更能了解宗教教派,因为家庭往往在忏悔上是内向的. 然而,这种信息分布不均。 最没有特色的名字属于较小的基督教教派,其姓氏出自一个与较大邻居共有的黎凡丁阿拉伯语祖先.

blocks.en: Unfortunately, the last census in Lebanon was conducted in 1932 under French supervision, so the geographic distribution of sect from external sources is not available. Therefore, for the purposes of this validation exercise, we form geographic priors using the voter file itself. Specifically for each voter, we calculate the share of each sect among the registrants of the voter’s “locality”, which is a formal administrative term referring to towns and villages, aggregated from the self-reported sects in the registry itself (there are 1,550 1{,}550 localities).
blocks.zh: 遗憾的是,黎巴嫩上一次人口普查是在1932年由法国监督进行的,因此没有外部来源的教派的地理分布. 因此,为了这一验证工作的目的,我们利用选民档案本身建立地理前科。 具体地说,我们计算每个选区在选民 " 所在地 " 登记人中所占的份额,这是一个正式的行政术语,指城镇和村庄,从登记本身自我报告的选区中汇总起来(共有1 550 1{}550个选区)。

blocks.en: Our downstream analysis uses locality-level ℓ \ell BISG predictions to estimate the age composition of each sect at the district level ( n = 29 n=29 ). The age composition of Lebanon’s sectarian groups is politically consequential because political representation is explicitly allocated along sectarian lines. Based on the 1932 census, which found Christians to constitute 51% of the population, the 1943 National Pact allocated parliamentary seats to Christians and Muslims in a 55–45 ratio. Following fifteen years of sectarian civil war, the 1989 Taif Agreement revised this allocation to an equal 50–50 split. By that time, however, unofficial estimates placed the Muslim share of the population at roughly 70% ( Faour, 2007 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们的下游分析利用地区一级l\ell BISG预测来估计地区一级每个教派的年龄组成(n=29n=29)。 黎巴嫩各教派团体的年龄构成具有政治后果,因为政治代表性明确按照教派划分。 1932年人口普查发现基督徒占总人口的51%,根据这次人口普查,1943年的"国家协约"以55-45的比例将议会席位分配给基督徒和穆斯林. 经过十五年的宗派内战后,1989年的"塔伊夫协议"将这一分配修改为等分50-50分. 然而,到那时,非官方估计认为穆斯林人口约占人口的70%(Faour,2007年)。

blocks.en: Because younger cohorts are disproportionately Muslim, a proposal to lower the voting age from 21 21 to 18 18 , endorsed by parliament in 2009, has stalled amid concerns that expanding the electorate to younger voters would place Christian confessions at a substantial numerical disadvantage ( Faour, 2007 ) . Although no census has been conducted since 1932, in part to avoid reigniting sectarian conflict over the demographic balance, sectarian affiliation continues to be recorded in the electoral rolls because civil status in Lebanon is administered by confession and parliamentary seats are allocated by sect.
blocks.zh: 由于年轻群体穆斯林比例过高,2009年议会批准的将投票年龄从21岁21岁降低到18岁18岁的建议陷入了停顿,因为担心将选民扩大到年轻选民将使基督教徒的忏悔在人数上处于严重劣势(Faour,2007年)。 虽然自1932年以来没有进行过人口普查,部分是为了避免宗派在人口平衡问题上重新爆发冲突,但宗派归属继续被记录在选民名册上,因为黎巴嫩的公民身份由忏悔管理,议会席位由教派分配.

blocks.en: Without a published surname table, we construct lists using an approach similar to the one employed in Section 5.2 . Specifically, we use Gemini 3.0 Flash to propose prompts written in Arabic (see Appendix A7 for details). As done in the previous applications, we make six separate model calls per prompt at temperature 1.0 1.0 , rank the surnames by the number of calls that returned them, and retain up to 1,000 1{,}000 unique surnames for each sect. The Maronite and Druze lists contain 861 861 and 853 853 surnames, respectively; the other five contain 1,000 1{,}000 .
blocks.zh: 没有公布的姓氏表,我们采用类似于第5.2节所采用的方法构建名单。 具体来说,我们使用双子座 3.0 Flash来提议用阿拉伯语写的提示(详见附录A7)。 与以往的应用一样,我们在1.0 1.0 温度下每秒发出6个单独的型号呼叫,按返回的呼叫次数对姓氏进行排序,并为每个区保留最多1000 1{}000个独特的姓氏. 马龙派和德鲁兹人名单中分别有861个861个和853个853个姓氏;其他5个则有1000个1{,}000个.

blocks.en: We embed surnames using the paraphrase-multilingual-mpnet-base-v2 model ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2020 ) , which accommodates Arabic script, instead of the E5 encoder used in the previous applications. In Step 4 of Algorithm 1 , the list-membership models, one per sect list, are fit on all registrants. The models score each surname out-of-sample across five folds that randomly partition the distinct surnames, with the number of epochs selected by cross-validation within each training set. The remaining steps follow Algorithm 1 , with K = 57,567 K=57{,}567 clusters chosen by applying Algorithm 2 to all 3,661,930 3{,}661{,}930 registrants.
blocks.zh: 我们使用配音-多语言-mpnet-base-v2模型(Reimers and Gurevich, 2020)来嵌入姓氏,该模型可以容纳阿拉伯字母,而不是之前应用中使用的E5编码器. 在"算法一"第4步中,列表成员模式,每节列表一个,适合所有注册者. 模型对每个姓氏进行取出样本的分数,取出5个折叠,随机划分出不同的姓氏,在每个训练集内通过交叉验证选择的时代数. 剩下的步骤遵循了算法 1 ,其中K = 57,567 K = 57{,}567 个集群通过将算法 2 应用到所有 3,661,930 3{,}661{,}930 注册者中来选择.

blocks.en: Table 3 : Quality of the seven LLM sect lists on the Lebanese voter registry. “Coverage” is the share of a sect’s registrants carrying a surname on that sect’s list, and “Precision” the share of the registrants carrying a list surname who belong to the sect. Lists contain up to 1,000 1{,}000 unique surnames.
blocks.zh: 表3:黎巴嫩选民登记册上7个LLM分区名单的质量。 " 封号 " 是指教派登记人在该教派名单上的姓的份额,以及属于该教派的 " 封号 " 登记人在该教派名单上的姓的份额。 列表中包含多达1,000 1{,}000个独有姓氏.

blocks.en: We evaluate the quality of LLM sect lists using an approach similar to the one used in the previous applications. Table 3 reports coverage and precision for each of the seven sects, both as computed from the recorded sects and as estimated from the locality system, using the locality sect shares as the geographic prior and no individual labels (Section 4.3 ). The estimates align closely to their corresponding ground-truths with the only exception being the estimated precision for Armenian Orthodox, which overestimates precision by 16 ppt.
blocks.zh: 我们采用与以往应用相似的方法来评价LLM分节列表的质量. 表3报告七个科的覆盖范围和准确性,从记录的科和从地方系统估计,均以地方科的股份为地理上以前和没有个人标签(第4.3节)。 估计数与其相应的地面实况很相符合,唯一的例外是亚美尼亚东正教徒的估计精确度,高估了16ppt的精确度。

blocks.en:
Across the groups, the Armenian lists yield the lowest coverage but the highest precision, while the Druze and Roman Catholic lists hold surnames that cover most registrants of those sects as well as many non-members. The sect lists also overlap more often than any of the American lists: 57.1 % 57.1\% of registrants have a surname that belongs to more than one list.
Our overall list quality measure is D ⁡ ( 𝚷 ) = 0.36 D(\bm{\Pi})=0.36 , which is similar to its ground truth 0.33 0.33 based on individual sectarian memberships, suggesting that the Lebanese lists are similar in quality to the American lists.
blocks.zh:
在各个群体中,亚美尼亚人名单的覆盖率最低,但准确度最高,而德鲁兹人和罗马天主教名单的姓氏涵盖这些教派的大多数登记人以及许多非成员。 本节列表也比任何美国列表更频繁地重叠:57.1%的注册者有属于多个列表的姓氏.
我们的列表总质量衡量标准是D QQ ( ) = 0.36 D (\bm\Pi}) = 0.36,这与它基于个别宗派成员的底线真理相类似 0.33 0.33,说明黎巴嫩列表的质量与美国列表相似.

blocks.en: We compare the empirical performance of ℓ \ell BISG based on the LLM lists against that of geography alone prediction as a baseline. Aside from constructing the geographic prior, the sect recorded in the voter file is used only for evaluation. As shown in Figure 7 , locality alone (grey dots) already predicts sect well because most localities are confessionally homogeneous. Still, ℓ \ell BISG (red solid line) improves on locality-alone prediction for every sect, though only marginally for the Shia, and by the most for the Armenian Orthodox, whose average precision rises from 0.48 0.48 under geography alone to 0.73 0.73 ; the Armenian Orthodox list is the most precise of the seven (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 根据LLM列表,我们比较了I\ell BISG的经验性表现,并将仅地理学预测作为基线。 除了构建地理前端外,选民档案中记录的段落仅用于评价. 如图7所示,单是地方(灰点)已经很好地预测了教派,因为大多数地方在忏悔上是同质的。 然而,我仍然对每个教派(尽管对什叶派来说只是略微的)和亚美尼亚东正教徒(仅地理上的平均精确度就从0.480.48提高到了0.73.73;亚美尼亚东正教徒名单是7个教派中最精确的)(表3)。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Precision and recall for ℓ \ell BISG and geography alone for the seven principal Lebanese sects, by confession (rows) and sect (columns), under the locality-level prior ( n = 1,550 n=1{,}550 ; ℓ \ell BISG red solid, geography grey dotted) and the district-level prior ( n = 29 n=29 ; ℓ \ell BISG blue dashed, geography dark grey dot-dashed).
blocks.zh: 图7:黎巴嫩7个主要教派的BISG的精确度和召回率,按招供(行)和分会(分会),在先前的地级(n=1 550 n=1{,}550;l=ell BISG红色固体,地缘灰点)和之前的地级(n=29 n=29;l=ell BISG蓝色分会,地缘暗灰色分会)。

blocks.en: The Muslim sects and the Druze are predicted best, with average precision above 0.94 0.94 , and the smaller Christian sects worst, at 0.55 0.55 for Roman Catholics and 0.64 0.64 for Roman Orthodox because their surnames are shared with the larger Christian sects. A low-precision list still supports precise predictions. The Roman Catholic list has a precision of only 0.08 0.08 at a recall equal to its coverage of 0.61 0.61 (Table 3 ), whereas the ℓ \ell BISG posterior reaches a precision of 0.47 0.47 at the same recall. This is because the posterior also draws on geography and on the other six lists.
blocks.zh: 穆斯林教派和德鲁兹教派的预测最好,平均精度为0.94 0.94分,较小的基督教教派最差,罗马天主教徒为0.55 0.55分,罗马东正教徒为0.64 0.64分,因为他们的姓氏与较大的基督教教派共有. 低精度列表仍然支持精确的预测. 罗马天主教列表的精确度仅为0.080.08, 相当于其覆盖的0.61 0.61 (表3),而l\ell BISG后缀在同一回召时的精确度为0.47 0.47。 这是因为后人也借鉴了地理学和其他6个列表.

blocks.en: Moreover, if we only look at the localities where no single sect comprises more than 90% of the roll (43% of 1,550 1,550 localities), ℓ \ell BISG outperforms geography alone by between 0.05 0.05 (Roman Catholic) and 0.26 0.26 (Armenian Orthodox) in average precision, and by 0.10 0.10 to 0.14 0.14 for the three largest sects.
blocks.zh: 此外,如果我们只看看没有一个宗派占卷数90%以上的地区(在1 550 1 550个地区中占43%),那么,仅BISG的地理表现就平均精确地超过了0.05 (罗马天主教)和0.26 (亚美尼亚东正教),而三个最大的宗派的地理表现则比0.10 0.10至0.140.14。

blocks.en: If we use the more heterogeneous district-level ( n = 29 n=29 ) share as the geographic prior instead of the locality, ℓ \ell BISG (blue dashed line) outperforms district-alone prediction (dark grey dot-dashed line) by between 0.01 0.01 (Roman Catholic) and 0.41 0.41 (Armenian Orthodox) in average precision. However, the downstream age estimates in Figure 9 become less accurate when probabilities are calculated at the district level, with the RMSE rising for six of the seven sects. This is because the coarser prior discards within-district geographic information.
blocks.zh: 如果我们使用地理上更相异的区级(n = 29n = 29)份额,则我/ell BISG(蓝破线)在平均精确度上比地区单独预测(暗灰色多点线)高出0.01 (罗马天主教)和0.41 (亚美尼亚东正教)之间。 然而,图9中的下游年龄估计在地区一级计算概率时变得不太准确,7个教派中的6个教派的RMSE上升了. 这是因为在区内地理信息中,先行减少的弃鱼。

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Calibration of estimated individual sect probabilities based on ℓ \ell BISG (LLM lists) for the seven principal Lebanese sects, by confession (rows) and sect (columns). The dashed diagonal marks perfect agreement between estimated probabilities and observed proportions. The area of each circle is proportional to the number of registrants in the bin.
blocks.zh: 图8:根据黎巴嫩7个主要教派的I-ell BISG(LLM清单),按供词(行)和教派(分栏),校准估计的个别教派概率。 破碎的对角标志在估计概率和观察到的比例之间完全一致。 每个圆圈的面积与本站的注册人数成正比.

blocks.en: Figure 8 shows that the predicted individual sect probabilities based on ℓ \ell BISG are well calibrated for the Maronites, the Muslim sects, and the Druze, whose reliability curves lie close to the diagonal. The three smaller Christian sects are over-predicted at high probabilities. Among registrants assigned a probability near 0.98 0.98 of being Armenian Orthodox, 0.75 0.75 are; most of the remainder are Armenian Catholics and Armenian Protestants in the residual class, since the Armenian Orthodox list identifies Armenian surnames rather than the denomination. The expected calibration error is nevertheless low for every sect, from 0.004 0.004 for the Druze to 0.015 0.015 for the Roman Catholics, because most registrants receive a probability near zero for any given sect.
blocks.zh: 图8显示,基于l\ell BISG的预测个体宗派概率对马龙派,回教宗派,德鲁兹宗的可靠性曲线接近对角. 三个较小的基督教教派在高概率上被过度预测. 在登记者中,有近0.98.0.98人被指定为亚美尼亚东正教徒的概率,其中0.75.0.75人;其余大部分是亚美尼亚天主教徒和亚美尼亚新教徒,属于剩余阶层,因为亚美尼亚东正教徒名单确定了亚美尼亚人的姓氏而不是教派。 然而,每个教派的预期校正误差都很低,从德鲁兹教派的0.004.004到罗马天主教徒的0.015.0.015,因为大多数登记者对任何特定教派的概率都接近于零。

blocks.en: We also evaluate the validity of the downstream analysis of age based on the estimated ℓ \ell BISG individual sect probabilities under the locality-level prior. The estimand is the share of each sect born in 1985 1985 or later within each district. This share varies across the sects, ranging from 12.9 % 12.9\% among Armenian Orthodox to 28.4 % 28.4\% among Shia. We estimate it for each sect within districts using separate target-versus-rest BIRDiE models with a saturated district specification, among the 90.2 % 90.2\% of registrants with a recorded birth year. We then compute the bias and RMSE over every sect-by-district pair, weighting each pair by its expected number of sect members under the geographic prior. We evaluate at the district level rather than at the locality level of the prior because most localities are confessionally homogeneous, such that geography alone already recovers the age composition of each sect within most localities. Again, we compare these estimates against using geography alone.
blocks.zh: 我们还根据地区一级的个别教派概率估计数,评估下游年龄分析的有效性。 estimand是1985年或以后在每个区出生的每个教派的份额. 这一比例在各教派各有不同,从亚美尼亚东正教徒的12.9% 12.9%到什叶派的28.4% 28.4%。 据我们估计,各地区内每个教派都使用具有饱和区规格的BIRDIE独立目标模式,在有记录的出生年份的登记者中占90.2%。 然后,我们计算每一区区对的偏差和RMSE, 将每一区对的偏差和RMSE按其预期的区前成员数加权。 我们评估的是地区一级,而不是先前地区一级,因为大多数地区是同质的,因此仅地理就已经恢复了大多数地区每个教派的年龄组成。 我们再次将这些估计数同仅使用地理学进行比较。

blocks.en: Figure 9 shows that across the 202 202 sect-by-district pairs, ℓ \ell BISG reduces the overall RMSE of the geographic baseline by about 68 % 68\% , from 5.9 5.9 to 1.9 1.9 ppts. RMSE (bottom panel) is lower for all seven sects, and absolute bias (top panel) is lower for six.
blocks.zh: 图9显示,在202 202个区对中,I\ell BISG将地理基线的总体RMSE减少约68% 68%,从5.9 5.9ppt减少到1.9 1.9ppt。 RMSE(下方面板)对于所有七个分会来说都较低,而绝对偏差(上方面板)对于六个分会来说都较低.

blocks.en: The size of the reduction reflects two separate components: how well geography alone recovers the sect due to residential segregation, and how well surnames identify group members. The Roman Catholics, whose members are older and dispersed as a minority across districts, have a baseline RMSE of 10.1 10.1 ppts, of which ℓ \ell BISG removes 54 % 54\% . The largest proportional reductions are for the Shia, from 5.8 5.8 to 1.1 1.1 ppts ( 82 % 82\% ), and the Sunni, from 4.1 4.1 to 0.8 0.8 ppts ( 80 % 80\% ).
blocks.zh: 缩减的大小反映了两个不同的部分:由于住宅隔离,仅地理就恢复了该教派,而姓氏如何识别出群体成员. 罗马天主教徒的年龄较大,作为少数民族分散在各区,其基线RMSE为10.1ppt,其中我/ell BISG删除了54%的54\%. 比例下降最大的是什叶派,从5.8 5.8到1.1 1.1 ppt (82% 82\%),逊尼派从 4.1 4.1到0.8 ppt (80% 80\%).

blocks.en: Overall, we find that ℓ \ell BISG predicts sectarian memberships with average precision between 0.55 0.55 and 0.98 0.98 , improves on geography alone for every sect – though the extent depends on the precision of the initial geographic probabilities – and reduces the error of the geographic baseline on the district-level estimand by about 68 % 68\% . This validation demonstrates the potential application of ℓ \ell BISG outside of the United States, to non-English names, and to a non-traditional group membership for which surnames are informative.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们发现,I\ell BISG以平均精确度在0.55 0.55至0.98 0.98之间预测宗派成员,每个宗派仅改善地理状况 — — 尽管其程度取决于最初地理概率的精确性 — — 并减少地区一级估计的地理基线误差约68 % 68 % 。 这一验证表明,I\ellBISG在美国境外、对非英文名称以及姓氏信息丰富的非传统团体成员的潜在应用。

blocks.en: 6 Concluding Remarks
blocks.zh: 6 结论意见

blocks.en: Bayesian Improved Surname Geocoding (BISG) and its variants have become the standard method for predicting individual race in the US. However, the requirement of race-name frequency tables has severely limited the applicability of BISG beyond this specific context. Often, these methods have been inapplicable beyond the coarse racial categories defined by the Census Bureau and outside the US, where such information is rarely available.
blocks.zh: Bayesian改进了姓氏地理编码(BISG)及其变体已经成为预测美国个体种族的标准方法. 然而,种族名称频率表的要求严重限制了BISG在此具体背景之外的适用性. 这些方法往往在人口普查局界定的粗鲁种族类别之外和美国以外地区不适用,因为美国很少有这种资料。

blocks.en: In this paper, we overcome this difficulty by developing list-powered BISG ( ℓ \ell BISG), which only requires group-specific name lists that can easily be obtained from an LLM. Importantly, when geographic prevalence information is available, the only new assumption is a rank condition on geographic prevalence that will often be satisfied if the groups of interest have at least some geographic variation. That is, ℓ \ell BISG only imposes this single additional assumption beyond what is required for the standard BISG method.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们通过开发具有列表功能的BISG(l\ell BISG)来克服这一困难,这只要求能够从LLM中轻松获得特定群体的名字列表. 重要的是,在获得地理普遍程度信息时,唯一的新假设是地理普遍程度的等级条件,如果利益群体至少有某些地域差异,这种条件往往会得到满足。 也就是说,l\ell BISG只强制规定这个单一的额外假设,超出了标准BISG方法的要求.

blocks.en: ℓ \ell BISG works by using a previously unrecognized consequence of the standard BISG assumption that surname and geography are independent given group membership. If a variable B B predictive of group membership (such as surname, surname embeddings, or embedding clusters) is not directly related to geography conditional on group membership (and if group membership has a geographic pattern), then B B will also exhibit a geographic pattern that indirectly reveals how B B relates to group membership. By setting up a system of equations, we are able to recover that relationship, which can in turn be used to produce BISG probabilities.
blocks.zh: l\ell BISG通过使用标准BISG假设的先前未确认的结果,即姓氏和地理是独立的给定的团体成员资格而工作. 如果一个可变的B B 预言组成员(如姓氏,姓氏嵌入,或嵌入组)与以组成员为条件的地理学没有直接关系(如果组成员具有地域模式),那么B B也会显示出一种地理模式,间接地揭示出B 与组成员的关系. 通过建立一个等式系统,我们能够恢复这种关系,而这种关系又可用于产生BISG概率。

blocks.en: Building on our earlier work of embedding-powered BISG ( Dasanaike and Imai, 2026 , eBISG;) , ℓ \ell BISG uses a proxy task of predicting list membership from name embeddings followed by clustering of those predictions to construct such a variable B B . Under additional assumptions on list quality, we have also shown how to extend ℓ \ell BISG to settings in which prior information about subgroup geographic prevalence is not available.
blocks.zh: 根据我们早先的嵌入动力BISG的工作(Dasanaike and Imai, 2026, eBISG;),l\ellBISG使用一个代用任务,从名字嵌入中预测名单成员,然后对这些预测进行分组来构建这样一个可变B B. 在关于清单质量的其他假设下,我们还表明如何将l\ell BISG扩展至没有关于分组地理流行率的先前信息的环境。

blocks.en: Our empirical validations show that the performance of ℓ \ell BISG is comparable to the standard BISG in terms of precision, accuracy, calibration, and downstream estimation performance — more so when lists are of higher quality. This is even though the former only requires group specific name lists. The case where geographic priors are unavailable is much more challenging, but when lists are distinctive enough, we are able to achieve comparable performance to standard BISG. Ultimately, ℓ \ell BISG represents a substantial improvement over using a geographic prior alone when standard BISG is not applicable.
blocks.zh: 我们的经验验证表明,l\ellBISG的性能在精度,准确度,校准度,下游估计性能方面都与标准的BISG相当——在清单质量较高时更为如此. 即使前者只要求特定组别名称列表. 缺乏地理前科的情况更具挑战性,但是,如果名单足够明确,我们就能够取得与标准边界安全小组相似的业绩。 归根结底,在标准BISG不适用的情况下,I / ell BISG比仅使用一个地域大有改进。

blocks.en: Because one can use a large-language model to generate an informative name list essentially for any group, ℓ \ell BISG extends probabilistic inference to fine-grained ethnic groups, to settings outside the United States, and to subgroups within a coarse racial group. We expect ℓ \ell BISG to considerably widen the applicability of probabilistic prediction methods that estimate group disparities when their membership is not observed.
blocks.zh: 因为人们可以使用一个大语言模型来生成一个信息性的名字列表,基本上针对任何群体,所以l\ell BISG将概率推论延伸至精细的种族群体,美国以外的环境,以及粗糙的种族群体内的分组. 我们期望我/埃利诺-伊格尔斯集团大大地扩大概率预测方法的适用性,这种预测方法在不观察群体成员时估计群体差异。

blocks.en: Future research could improve ℓ \ell BISG in several directions. One direction is to extend our approach to recovering unavailable subgroup geographic prevalence to settings where additional prior information about list quality and overlap is available. Another is to explore alternatives to our combination of list-based prediction and K-means clustering for constructing the low-dimensional summary variable.
blocks.zh: 未来的研究可以在几个方向上改进我对BISG的销售。 一个方向是,将我们恢复不存在的次级地域流行率的办法扩大到有关于清单质量和重叠的额外事先信息的地方。 另一个是探索替代我们基于列表的预测和K-分子集群组合的替代方法来构建低维的汇总变量.

blocks.en: As we noted in Section 2 , in the settings where geographic priors are already available, the ℓ \ell BISG framework can be applied effectively without lists so long as embeddings are spatially clustered by the group of interest. However, when geographic information is not available, and for diagnostics, lists are essential. In some of our applications, we find that list-guided clustering only moderately improves on direct clustering. Still, it remains an open question how the added value of lists varies across application types and embedding models.
blocks.zh: 正如我们在第2节所指出,在已有地理前科的环境下,只要嵌入物被利益集团在空间上分组,l\ell BISG框架就可以在没有列表的情况下得到有效的应用. 然而,在无法获得地理信息的情况下,为了诊断,清单至关重要。 在我们的一些应用中,我们发现,以清单为指南的分组在直接分组方面仅略有改进。 然而,清单的附加值如何因应用类型和嵌入模型而异,仍是一个未决问题。

blocks.en: Broadly, this paper offers a general strategy for incorporating information from (LLM-generated) lists and name embeddings into well-calibrated probabilities that support valid downstream inference while accounting for uncertainty in unobserved group membership.
blocks.zh: 广义地说,本文件为将(LLM产生的)清单中的信息和名字嵌入经过适当校准的概率提供了一个总体战略,这些概率支持有效的下游推论,同时对未观察到的集团成员的不确定性进行核算。

blocks.en: Appendix A2 Using the list score directly
blocks.zh: 附录A2 直接使用列表分数

blocks.en: Using the Florida data, we show that the list score f r , e = ℙ ⁡ ( L r = 1 ∣ E = e ) f_{r,e}=\Pr(L_{r}{=}1\mid E=e) cannot serve as the race probability on its own. That is, the probability that a name is on the list does not equal the probability that a person with that name belongs to the group. This is because lists have imperfect precision – some on the list are not in group r r and some off it are in the group – and because lists ignore base rates.
blocks.zh: 使用佛罗里达州的数据,我们显示列表得分f r,e = P ⁡ (L r = 1 ∣ E = e ) f r,e }=\ Pr (L _{r}{=} 1\mid E = e)不能单独作为比赛概率. 也就是说,一个名字在名单上的概率并不等于有一个名字的人属于这个团体的概率. 这是因为列表的精度不完美 — — 列表中有些不是r组,有些则在组中 — — 并且列表忽略了基准率.

blocks.en: Figure A1 : Calibration of the raw LLM list score f r = P ⁡ ( L r = 1 ∣ E ) f_{r}=P(L_{r}{=}1\mid E) used directly as a race probability (blue, dashed) against ℓ \ell BISG (red, solid), by race, on the Florida registrants. The dashed diagonal indicates perfect agreement between estimated probabilities and observed proportions. The area of each circle is proportional to the number of registrants in the bin.
blocks.zh: 图A1:原始LLM榜单分数的校正fr=P  (Lr=1∣ E. f_{r}=P (L_{r}{=}1\mid E) 直接用作比赛概率(蓝色,破损)来对抗l ell BISG (红色,固态),通过比赛,在佛罗里达注册人上. 破碎的对角表示在估计概率和观察到的比例之间完全一致。 每个圆圈的面积与本站的注册人数成正比.

blocks.en: Figure A1 demonstrates that f f (blue dashed line) is not well calibrated. The failure is most dramatic for White, the majority group, whose raw scores substantially underpredict its prevalence. For comparison, Figure A1 also includes the surname-only ℓ \ell BISG probabilities based on the LLM lists of Section 5.1 , which adjust the raw scores using information gained from the geographic prevalence information.

blocks.en: Figure A6 compares the recall at a precision of 0.5 0.5 and the average precision of ℓ \ell BISG under two approaches to the dimension reduction described in Section 2.4 . Our proposed approach is K-means clustering on the vectors of log-odds of list scores f e = ( f 1 , e , … , f d ℛ , e ) f_{e}=(f_{1,e},...,f_{d_{\mathcal{R}},e}) . We compare this to running K-means clustering on the embeddings directly, which relies more heavily on the embeddings being clustered by group membership even if they come from an embedding model trained for other tasks.
blocks.zh: 图A6比较了第2.4节所述减少维度的两种办法下的召回精度为0.5和l\ell BISG的平均精度。 我们提议的方法是用列表分数 f e (f 1, e., f d R., e.) f = e (f_{ 1, e.), f_{d_{\ mathcal{R}}, e.) 的对数的向量进行组合。 我们将此与直接在嵌入物上运行的K-意指集群相比较,它更依赖于被组成员集群的嵌入物,即使它们来自一个为其他任务而训练的嵌入模型.

blocks.en: In the Florida example, clustering the list scores yields more informative clusters than clustering the raw embeddings directly for the rare Asian group when the number of clusters is moderate. At K = 500 K=500 , the average precision for the Asian group is 0.25 0.25 using the list scores compared to 0.15 0.15 with the raw embeddings. The recall for each approach at a precision of 0.5 0.5 is 0.21 0.21 compared to 0.03 0.03 , respectively (Figure A6 ). For the other three groups, the two approaches perform similarly at every selected K K . At the K = 7,500 K=7{,}500 selected by Algorithm 2 , both approaches perform similarly for every group. Differential performance under list scores and raw embeddings therefore appears to arise primarily when there are too few observations to estimate many clusters.
blocks.zh: 在佛罗里达州的例子中,对列表分数进行分组,比在分组数量适中时对稀有亚洲组直接进行原始嵌入的分组产生更多的信息. 在K = 500 K = 500时,使用列表分数的亚洲组平均精度为0.25 0.25,而用原始嵌入法的分数为0.15 0.15. 每一种方法的召回精度为0.5 0.5为0.21 0.21,而0.03为0.03(图A6)。 对于其他三个组,两种方法在每一选定的KK中都具有类似的作用。 在K=7,500 K=7{,}由算法2所选择的500个方法中,两种方法对每个组都具有类似的性能. 因此,在清单分数和原始嵌入数下,表现的差异似乎主要出现在观测数据太少而无法估计许多组的情况下。

blocks.en: In the Lebanese voter file (Figure A7 ), clustering the list scores rather than the raw embeddings directly yields more informative clusters for the Armenian Orthodox, the smallest sect, when the number of clusters is small or moderate. At K = 100 K=100 , the average precision for the Armenian Orthodox is 0.69 0.69 using the list scores compared to 0.64 0.64 with the raw embeddings, and the recall at a precision of 0.5 0.5 is 0.87 0.87 compared to 0.80 0.80 . For the other six sects, the two approaches perform similarly, and at the K = 57,567 K=57{,}567 selected by Algorithm 2 , they perform similarly for every sect.
blocks.zh: 在黎巴嫩选民档案(图A7)中,将列表分数分组,而不是原始嵌入,当分组数量小或适度时,直接为亚美尼亚正教这一最小的教派产生更多的信息. 在K = 100 K = 100时,亚美尼亚正统派使用列表分数的平均精度为0.69 0.69分,而使用原始嵌入法的精度为0.64 0.64分,而收复精度为0.5 0.5分为0.87 0.87分,而使用0.80 0.80分. 对于其他六个分会,两种方法的性能类似,在算法2所选择的K=57,567 K=57{,}567中,它们对于每个分会的性能类似.

blocks.en: A7.2 Historical census
blocks.zh: A7.2 历史普查

blocks.en: We use Gemini 3.0 Flash to write a meta prompt that asks the model to write the descriptions itself: You are helping build surname lists for { origin } immigrants to the United States around 1900. Propose exactly three short descriptions of subgroups that together cover that immigrant population, distinguished by the region they came from or the region of America where they settled. Each description must complete the sentence ‘list 300 common surnames (last names only) of …’. Return only the three descriptions, one per line, with no numbering. The three descriptions returned for each origin are substituted into the skeleton: List { n } common SURNAMES (last names only) of { description } . Maximize diversity; avoid famous/celebrity surnames. One surname per line, UPPERCASE, no first names, no numbering, no commentary. For the Chinese and Japanese lists of Section 5.2 , the meta prompt refers to the population “in the United States and Hawaii around 1900”, and the skeleton adds “spelled as they were written in American census and immigration records of that period”. For the white, Black, and American Indian lists of Section 5.2 , the meta prompt refers to “white Americans”, “Black Americans”, and “American Indians” “in the United States around 1900”, and the descriptions are substituted into the skeleton above. Table A1 lists every description used.
blocks.zh: 我们用双子座 3.0 Flash来写一个元提示,要求模型自己写描述: 你正在帮助为1900年左右的美国移民建立姓氏名单。 具体提出三个分组的简短说明,这些分组共同涵盖移民人口,按他们来自或定居的美国地区加以区分。 每次描述必须填写 " 列出.的300个通用姓氏(只有上个姓) " 。 只返回三个描述,每行一个,没有编号. 返回的关于每个来源的三种描述被替换为骨架: List { n } { sURNAMES (仅限上个名字)} 。 使多样性最大化;避免出名/名人姓. 每行取一姓,UPPERCASE,无出名,无编号,无评论. 对于第5.2节的中日名单,元提示指“1900年左右在美国和夏威夷的人口”,骨架上还加上了“按当时美国人口普查和移民记录中写明的拼写”。 对于第5.2节的白人、黑人和美国印第安人名单,元提示指“美国白人”、“美国黑人”和“美国印第安人”,这些描述被替换为上述骨架。 表A1列出了所使用的所有说明。

blocks.en: Table A3 reports the Census lists under values of τ \tau ranging from 0.20 0.20 to 0.60 0.60 . The White, Hispanic, and Asian lists are largely unchanged. For these groups, the top 1,000 1{,}000 surnames by the ranking rule clear even the highest value of τ \tau . The Black list is far more sensitive, clearly trading off coverage for precision as τ \tau rises. τ \tau also determines the extent to which the group lists have overlapping surnames: at τ = 0.20 \tau=0.20 , 7.0 % 7.0\% of registrants have a surname that belongs to two groups, while at τ = 0.30 \tau=0.30 , that share falls to 0.04 % 0.04\% , and above τ = 0.30 \tau=0.30 , it is zero. We therefore use τ = 0.30 \tau=0.30 , the smallest measured floor at which the lists are close to disjoint.
